title_translated: SKIM：基于选择性知识引导掩码的大型语言模型代理剪枝
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地部署于结构化生成场景中，语法约束在推理时强制输出格式。现有压缩方法主要针对无约束生成，而我们首次发现一个根本性不匹配：在结构化生成下，语法约束将模型输出分布缩减为有效词元，且仅少数位置的logits对代理行为决策至关重要。基于此发现，我们提出SKIM（选择性知识引导掩码），首个面向结构化生成场景的LLM代理剪枝与蒸馏框架，其两个阶段均由词元角色指导。SKIM将词元位置划分为上下文、决策和格式三类，由此驱动两个互补维度：(1) 类别感知的剪枝显著性评分，保留对决策位置最相关参数；(2) 基于策略的蒸馏目标，使学生与教师在有效词元上对齐，并结合类别感知特征匹配。我们在工具调用基准和多步代理循环中，跨多个模型规模和稀疏度水平评估SKIM。SKIM始终优于基线，在高稀疏度环境下优势尤为明显，展示了类别感知压缩在部署时语法约束代理中的潜力。

summary: Language agents increasingly use persistent memory to record user preferences and procedures across sessions. We show that memory from benign interactions can cause unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks. We call this failure the memory trap. To study this issue, we compare behavior in sessions with and without memory across six frontier models (including Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable models and GPT-5.6). We evaluate these models in a range of settings. First, in autonomy experiments, we find that requests to skip confirmation during low-stakes coding chores lead agents to skip confirmation and verification on simulated high-stakes tasks in both coding and everyday life. We next study memories formed when users seek emotional support, or describe harm from uncritical feedback, and find these memories bias later judgments of mathematical work, arguments, and poems toward sycophancy or over-critique (respectively). Memory notes written during legitimate stale-test repairs lead agents to weaken correct tests that catch broken safeguards; these memories also increase cheating on ImpossibleBench, with larger increases for stronger Sonnet and Opus models. We show that memory traps can arise both from overgeneralizations in memory writing, and when acting on memory. These findings demonstrate that even benign interactions can lead to serious risks from memory systems, and thus motivate the need for new research into ensuring that agents preserve the scope of their memories.
title: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions
title_translated: 记忆陷阱：语言代理从良性交互中过度泛化
summary_translated: 语言代理越来越多地使用持久记忆来记录用户偏好和操作流程跨会话信息。我们发现，来自良性交互的记忆可能导致后续任务中出现不安全或不可靠的行为。我们将这种失败称为‘记忆陷阱’。为研究该问题，我们在六种前沿模型（包括Claude Sonnet、Opus、Fable模型及GPT-5.6）上比较了有记忆与无记忆会话中的行为表现。我们在多种设置下评估这些模型。首先，在自主性实验中，我们发现要求跳过低风险编码任务的确认步骤后，代理会在模拟高风险任务（包括编码和日常生活）中同样跳过确认与验证。接下来，我们研究用户寻求情感支持或描述因缺乏批判性反馈造成的伤害时形成的记忆，发现这些记忆会使得代理对数学作业、论点和诗歌的判断偏向阿谀奉承或过度批评。在合法的静态测试修复过程中写下的记忆笔记会导致代理削弱本应捕捉故障防护机制的有效测试；这些记忆还增加了在ImpossibleBench上的作弊行为，且更强的Sonnet和Opus模型增幅更大。我们证明，记忆陷阱既可能源于记忆书写中的过度泛化，也可能源于对记忆的执行。这些发现表明，即使是良性交互也可能引发严重风险，因此亟需新的研究以确保代理能够保持记忆范围的准确性。

summary: Linear attention reduces the quadratic sequence-length complexity of softmax attention by maintaining fixed-size recurrent states. However, these states scale quadratically with the representation dimension and require repeated data transfers during decoding, creating a substantial GPU memory bottleneck. Recent studies have revealed significant low-rank redundancy in recurrent states, suggesting opportunities for more efficient representations. We introduce SPARE (State Projection for Accelerated Recurrent Execution), a training-free method that exploits this redundancy through fixed low-dimensional subspaces, heterogeneous rank allocation, and lightweight write compensation. By performing recurrent reads and updates directly on compact states, SPARE reduces memory traffic without online decomposition or dense-state reconstruction. SPARE achieves 2.55x full-model decoding speedup, 7.49x lower recurrent-kernel DRAM traffic, and 3.31x lower peak GPU memory, while preserving better associative-retrieval accuracy than structured pruning at matched memory budgets.
title: SPARE: Fast Linear Attention Decoding with Compact Recurrent States
title_translated: SPARE：具有紧凑递归状态的快速线性注意力解码
summary_translated: 线性注意力通过维护固定大小的递归状态，将softmax注意力的二次序列长度复杂度降低。然而，这些状态随表示维度呈二次增长，并在解码过程中需要重复的数据传输，造成显著的GPU内存瓶颈。近期研究表明递归状态中存在显著的低秩冗余，提示更高效表示的可能性。我们提出SPARE（加速递归执行的状态投影），一种无需训练的方法，通过固定低维子空间、异质秩分配和轻量级写入补偿来利用这一冗余。通过直接在紧凑状态上执行递归读取和更新，SPARE在不进行在线分解或密集状态重建的情况下减少了内存流量。SPARE实现了2.55倍全模型解码速度提升，递归核DRAM流量降低7.49倍，峰值GPU内存降低3.31倍，同时在相同内存预算下比结构化剪枝具有更好的关联检索准确率。

summary: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) for code, which closely aligns with the practical needs of real-world software development, has sparked growing attention in repository-level code completion. However, existing Code LLMs present challenges in focusing on suitable contexts from the repository and in deeply reasoning about cross-file dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for repository-level code completion. To better understand both in-file and cross-file contexts, we employ identifier-driven intent recognition to capture completion intent, thereby improving the model's performance in real-world scenarios. To enhance cross-file reasoning, we propose a reward-driven completion learning to effectively reward in complex repository completion scenarios. To guide LLMs in completing code that aligns with intended functionality and repository context, we introduce a selective-exploration strategy that directs the model to focus on low-confidence, high-reward tokens, promoting the exploration of valuable, underexplored completion patterns. Experimental results show that our approach significantly improves the performance of Code LLMs. The code and the dataset are available at https://github.com/zhenlongDai/RepoCompletion.
title: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion with Reinforcement Learning in Real-World Scenarios
title_translated: 在真实场景中利用强化学习增强仓库级代码补全
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码领域的快速发展，紧密契合了真实世界软件开发的实际需求，引发了对仓库级代码补全的广泛关注。然而，现有的代码LLM在聚焦仓库中的合适上下文以及深入推理跨文件依赖关系方面仍面临挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的强化学习框架用于仓库级代码补全。为了更好地理解文件内和跨文件上下文，我们采用基于标识符的意图识别来捕捉补全意图，从而提升模型在真实场景中的表现。为增强跨文件推理能力，我们提出了奖励驱动的补全学习方法，在复杂的仓库补全场景中有效奖励高质量行为。为引导LLM生成符合预期功能和仓库上下文的代码，我们引入了一种选择性探索策略，使模型聚焦于低置信度、高奖励的token，促进对有价值但未充分探索的补全模式的探索。实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了代码LLM的性能。代码与数据集已公开于https://github.com/zhenlongDai/RepoCompletion。

summary: Peer-review comments check what a paper does and judge why it matters, but no existing scheme distinguishes these two evaluative acts. We argue that making these acts explicit and measuring how reliably LLMs identify them is a prerequisite for responsible LLM-assisted review analysis: humans need to inspect review judgments and their grounds. This defines a more honest mission for NLP in peer review than full automation. We present ReviewMap, a framework that classifies each comment as assessment of claims and scholarly standards or calibration of contribution value and venue fit, with finer-grained attributes applied conditionally by act type. Applied to 500 ICLR~2026 papers through multi-model LLM consensus, the act layer proves reliably automatable under the operational guideline (inter-model $κ\geq 0.75$), supported by five-human validation on 470 development comments, while the attribute layer requires human oversight, defining a measured automation boundary. At the corpus level, 17% of reviewer-paper instances contain no panel-coded calibration, and the panel-coded calibration share is nearly $3\times$ as high in Strengths as in Weaknesses. This boundary informs three affordances: a review guideline that operationalizes the assessment-then-calibration workflow for reviewers, a per-comment rebuttal strategy scaffold for authors, and a discussion-phase dashboard for area chairs.
title: ReviewMap: Mapping Evaluative Acts and Automation Boundaries in Peer-Review Comments
title_translated: ReviewMap：映射同行评审评论中的评价行为与自动化边界
summary_translated: 同行评审评论既检查论文做了什么，也判断其意义何在，但现有方案未能区分这两种评价行为。我们认为，将这些行为显式化并衡量LLM识别它们的可靠性，是负责任地使用LLM辅助评审分析的前提：人类需要审查评审判断及其依据。这为NLP在同行评审中的使命设定了更诚实的目标，而非完全自动化。我们提出ReviewMap框架，将每条评论分类为对主张与学术标准的评估，或对贡献价值与会议匹配度的校准，并根据行为类型有条件地应用更细粒度属性。通过对500篇ICLR 2026论文进行多模型LLM共识分析，行为层在操作指南下表现出可靠的可自动化性（模型间κ≥0.75），经五人验证的470条开发评论支持此结论；而属性层仍需人工监督，定义了适度的自动化边界。在语料层面，17%的审稿人-论文实例中无面板编码的校准内容，且‘优点’部分的校准占比接近‘缺点’部分的三倍。这一边界带来了三项可用性支持：一种操作化的‘评估后校准’工作流评审指南、作者用于逐条回应的策略支架，以及领域主席在讨论阶段使用的仪表板。

summary: Long-horizon role-playing dialogue requires consistent character identity, reliable memory, and context-sensitive interaction. We present a bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework that revises original-character memory, stable persona instructions, and a policy for constructing turn-level prompts. Repair outcomes also inform revisions to the updater's diagnostic rules, edit routing, and candidate selection. We specify the updater as a versioned policy with explicit inputs, editable fields, acceptance gates, and stopping conditions. An internal evaluation covers 50 original characters and five models, with two 100-round conversations per character-model pair: 500 conversations per condition. Across the pooled evaluated replies, the bad-response rate decreases from 14.00% (6,973/49,824) to 4.94% (2,459/49,793), a 9.06-percentage-point reduction and a 64.71% relative reduction. In 600 blinded human comparisons, RSI receives 294 wins, 187 ties, and 119 losses, yielding a 71.19% win rate among decisive judgments. The results support improved aggregate dialogue quality for the complete framework on the internal test distribution.
title: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Role-Playing Dialogue
title_translated: 长时程角色扮演对话的递归自我改进
summary_translated: 长时程角色扮演对话需要保持角色身份的一致性、可靠的记忆机制以及情境敏感的交互能力。我们提出一种有界递归自我改进（RSI）框架，用于修订原始角色记忆、稳定的人物指令以及构建回合级提示的策略。修复结果还用于更新更新器的诊断规则、编辑路由和候选选择策略。我们将更新器定义为具有明确输入、可编辑字段、接受门控和停止条件的版本化策略。内部评估涵盖50个原始角色和五个模型，每对角色-模型进行两轮100回合对话：共500次对话。在所有评估回复中，不良响应率从14.00%（6,973/49,824）降至4.94%（2,459/49,793），绝对降低9.06个百分点，相对减少64.71%。在600次盲测人类对比中，RSI获得294胜、187平、119负， decisive judgments中的胜率为71.19%。结果表明，该完整框架在内部测试分布上显著提升了整体对话质量。

summary: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our heelo.dev platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9$\times$ and 2.3$\times$ less time and 1.55$\times$ lower cost per completed task.
title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks

title_translated: 通往真实世界的最后一公里：代理原生原子作为解决现实任务的可复用构建模块
summary_translated: 如何让一个智能体端到端地处理真实世界任务？前沿模型虽自带工具链，但在真实世界基准测试中仍表现不足：在Terminal-Bench 4.0上，GPT-5.6 Sol搭配Codex仅完成37.3%的任务，Claude Opus 5搭配Claude Code完成51.8%。这些任务失败的关键在于从获取资源到应用资源之间的“最后一公里”。现有方法虽将资源置于可及范围，但应用资源的能力仍由调用者承担，导致每个工具链都需重新构建该能力。我们引入代理原生原子（agent-native primitives），即可复用的单元，为资源配备驻留的LLM以在上下文中应用资源，并与其他原子通信；同时提出HEELO（围绕演进的代理原生原子进行工具链工程以解决通往真实世界任务的最后一公里）框架，通过一组此类原子库构建每个任务的专用工具链。HEELO将任务所需的原子组合成特定任务图，根据环境证据验证结果，修正失败所涉及的原子，并在验证后接纳新或改进的原子。我们以八类原子家族实例化HEELO，每类针对一类任务，并在二十多个基准上进行评估。开发原子将Terminal-Bench 4.0的解决率从Codex下的37.3%提升至55.5%；任务定制的工具原子将Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1从种子工具链的60.0%提升至72.2%；工具原子将ToolBench通过率从55.8%提升至75.1%；导航原子将GAIA-Text-103准确率从45.6%提升至58.3%。在我们heelo.dev平台上的46个真实任务中，Claude Opus 5.5搭配Claude Code独立完成9个，GPT-6.1 Sol搭配Codex完成9个；当通过我们的MCP服务器接入HEELO后，分别完成39个和35个，耗时减少1.9×和2.3×，单位任务成本降低1.55×。

summary: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language model responses by spending additional computation at inference time, and the right amount of compute depends on the prompt. Adaptive TTC methods allocate compute based on signals of response quality such as observed rewards, often by stopping once the signal exceeds a fixed threshold, and generally measure cost by the number of generations or tokens. But in online serving, latency is also a cost: it grows with server load, so a method using a fixed threshold spends too little compute when generation is fast and too much when it is slow. For Best-of-$N$ sampling, a widely used TTC method, we propose a two-stage adaptive algorithm that draws an initial batch, then uses the observed rewards and the batch's latency to decide whether to draw a second batch and at what size by comparing expected improvement against predicted cost: it draws one when the first batch's best reward is below a threshold that decreases with the first batch's latency, without explicitly measuring server load. We map each reward to its value under the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the prompt's reward distribution, so the same tradeoff parameters can be reused across tasks; a regression fitted offline on other prompts predicts a distribution for the CDF value of the first batch's best reward, giving the expected improvement in closed form. We evaluate the method by simulation on a preference-based alignment benchmark, measuring generations-equivalent cost: generations plus latency, converted to generations. The method reaches Best-of-$N$'s reward at lower generations-equivalent cost, and conditioning on the measured first-batch latency saves at least as much of that cost as fixed-threshold (latency-unaware) baselines, and more when latency is highly variable, when it grows with batch size, and when the second batch's latency is highly predictable from the first's.
title: Latency-Aware Adaptive Best-of-$N$
title_translated: 面向延迟感知的自适应Best-of-$N$
summary_translated: 测试时计算（TTC）通过在推理阶段增加额外计算量来提升语言模型输出质量，而合适的计算量取决于输入提示。自适应TTC方法基于响应质量信号（如观察到的奖励）分配计算量，通常在信号超过固定阈值时停止，一般以生成次数或token数衡量成本。但在在线服务中，延迟也是一种成本：它随服务器负载增长，因此使用固定阈值的方法在生成速度快时计算不足，在慢时又过度消耗。针对广泛使用的TTC方法Best-of-$N$采样，我们提出一种两阶段自适应算法：先生成初始批次，再结合观察到的奖励和批次延迟，通过比较预期收益与预测成本来决定是否生成第二批次及规模大小——当第一批次的最佳奖励低于随延迟下降的阈值时才生成第二批，无需显式测量服务器负载。我们将每个奖励映射为其在提示奖励分布累积分布函数（CDF）下的值，使得同一组权衡参数可在不同任务间复用；通过离线拟合其他提示的回归模型，预测第一批次最佳奖励的CDF值分布，从而以闭式表达获得预期收益。我们在基于偏好的对齐基准上通过模拟评估该方法，以“生成等价成本”（生成次数加延迟，转换为等效生成次数）为指标。该方法在更低的生成等价成本下达到Best-of-$N$的奖励水平，且在测量第一批次延迟的前提下，节省的成本至少不低于固定阈值（延迟无关）基线，尤其在延迟高度可变、随批次增大而增长、且第二批次延迟可由第一批次高度预测的情况下，优势更为明显。

summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become an increasingly popular means of translating Large Language Model (LLM) hidden state vectors into a human-comprehensible list of features or symbols. As such, SAEs may provide insight into an LLM's knowledge representation and internal ``mental'' grammar - topics of pragmatic interest for mechanistic interpretation of AI behavior and of theoretical interest for the study of in silico representations of human language. Language models with fewer than 100M parameters, trained on small corpora, nonetheless exhibit strong grammatical competence and discourse coherence, despite producing content of limited reliability. We use SAEs that we trained on one such model (Pythia-70M) to conduct an in-depth examination of how a single grammatical phenomenon, number agreement, is represented and processed in an LLM. We demonstrate the mechanism and the methodology by which SAEs can be used to find and propagate ``plural noun'', ``plural matrix subject'', and ``generate a plural verb'' features which cause the LLM to produce plural verb forms such as ``are'', ``do'', or ``have'' instead of ``is'', ``does'', and ``has'' in response to prompts such as ``the men in the park''. We show that intervening to remove these features from the hidden states of plural subject noun tokens causes the model to produce singular verbs instead, and vice versa. We also show that corresponding ``singular noun'' and ``generate a singular verb'' features are not as effective for this task. This asymmetry suggests that Pythia-70m makes use of a privative representation of grammatical number in English. These findings replicated with larger LLMs Gemma-2-2b and Llama-3.1-8b yielded similar results. Our main contribution is a novel approach to the use of SAEs to understanding how LLMs encode human language that addresses a number of technical and methodological challenges.
title: Encoding and Propagation of Grammatical Number in Large Language Models
title_translated: 大型语言模型中语法数的编码与传播
summary_translated: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）已成为将大型语言模型（LLM）隐藏状态向量转换为人类可理解特征或符号列表的流行方法。因此，SAEs可能为LLM的知识表示和内部‘心理’语法提供洞察——这对人工智能行为的机制解释具有实际意义，也对人脑语言在计算机中的模拟研究具有理论价值。即使参数少于1亿、在小语料上训练的语言模型，仍表现出强大的语法能力和话语连贯性，尽管其生成内容的可靠性有限。我们使用在其中一个模型（Pythia-70M）上训练的SAEs，深入研究单一语法现象——数的一致性——在LLM中的表示与处理方式。我们展示了如何利用SAEs发现并传播‘复数名词’、‘复数主语’和‘生成复数动词’等特征，使模型在面对如‘公园里的男人’这类提示时，输出‘are’、‘do’或‘have’等复数动词形式，而非‘is’、‘does’或‘has’。我们证明，通过干预移除复数主语词元隐藏状态中的这些特征，模型会生成单数动词，反之亦然。同时，对应的‘单数名词’和‘生成单数动词’特征在此任务中效果较差。这种不对称性表明，Pythia-70M在英语中采用了否定性的语法数表征方式。在更大规模的LLM（Gemma-2-2b和Llama-3.1-8b）上的复现也得到了类似结果。我们的主要贡献是一种新颖的SAE使用方法，用于理解LLM如何编码人类语言，解决了多项技术和方法论挑战。

summary: Parallel block drafting accelerates speculative decoding by predicting multiple future positions in a single backbone pass, but on-device deployment constrains both drafter capacity and context storage. Under tight memory budgets, drafters must model long-range dependencies and fine-grained draft-position interactions without the growing KV-cache overhead of full-context attention. We propose HyFlash, a compact parallel drafter that introduces a prefix-memory prior to separate long-range context modeling from fine-grained draft-position interactions with limited capacity. Local attention captures recent context and draft-position interactions, while recurrent memory compresses historical target features into fixed-size states. This inductive bias enables effective local and long-range modeling with bounded draft-side memory. Experiments show that HyFlash achieves higher acceptance than full-context attention with substantially less KV storage and with larger gains for shallow drafters and long contexts.
title: HyFlash: A Prefix-Memory Prior for On-Device Speculative Decoding
title_translated: HyFlash：一种面向设备端推测解码的前缀记忆先验
summary_translated: 并行块草稿通过单次主干计算预测多个未来位置，从而加速推测解码，但设备端部署限制了草稿器容量和上下文存储能力。在严格的内存预算下，草稿器必须在不增加完整上下文注意力带来的KV缓存开销的前提下，建模长距离依赖关系和精细的草稿位置交互。我们提出HyFlash，一种紧凑的并行草稿器，引入前缀记忆先验，将长距离上下文建模与精细草稿位置交互分离，且容量有限。局部注意力捕捉近期上下文和草稿位置交互，而循环记忆将历史目标特征压缩为固定大小的状态。这种归纳偏置使得在有限草稿侧内存下实现有效的局部与长距离建模。实验表明，HyFlash在显著减少KV存储的情况下，实现了比全上下文注意力更高的接受率，并且对浅层草稿器和长上下文具有更大的增益。

summary: AI agents may consume massive tokens across a wide range of tasks, but how many of those tokens are really necessary? Although prior work has shown that agents can incur unexpectedly high token costs, we still lack a systematic way to identify and measure token waste. In this work, we introduce a unified framework for measuring token waste across heterogeneous agent systems. Our framework records and normalizes complete agent trajectories, identifies removable spans using an LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaJ), and maps the identified text spans back to the original trajectory for token-level measurement. We validate the identified waste through direct interventions by removing marked spans, resuming agent execution, and measuring changes in task outcomes and subsequent actions. In online pruning experiments, we remove 41-46% of the model's reasoning while largely preserving task performance across two distinct agent benchmarks. Using this framework, we analyze agents across multiple settings. Our analysis shows that token waste has a system-level structure that aggregate token usage alone cannot reveal. First, waste varies more across tasks and agent settings than across models. Second, reasoning and visible execution can exhibit different waste patterns. Third, different harnesses can introduce distinct sources of inefficiency even under the same model and task. Overall, our framework transforms token waste into an actionable optimization signal, enabling researchers and practitioners to train more efficient models, design better reasoning strategies, and optimize agent harnesses toward reducing unnecessary computation rather than merely reducing token usage.
title: How Do AI Agents Waste Your Money?
title_translated: AI代理如何浪费你的钱？
summary_translated: AI代理可能在各种任务中消耗大量token，但其中有多少是真正必要的？尽管先前工作已表明代理可能产生意外高昂的token成本，但我们仍缺乏系统性方法来识别和度量token浪费。本文提出一个统一框架，用于衡量异构代理系统中的token浪费。该框架记录并归一化完整的代理轨迹，使用大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge, LLMaJ）识别可移除片段，并将识别出的文本段落映射回原始轨迹以进行token级测量。我们通过直接干预——移除标记段落、恢复代理执行并测量任务结果和后续动作的变化——验证了所识别的浪费。在线剪枝实验中，我们移除了模型41%-46%的推理过程，同时在两个不同的代理基准测试中基本保持了任务性能。利用此框架，我们在多种设置下分析代理。分析显示，token浪费具有系统级结构，仅聚合token使用量无法揭示。首先，浪费在任务和代理设置间差异大于在模型间差异；其次，推理与可见执行可能表现出不同的浪费模式；第三，即使在同一模型和任务下，不同代理框架也可能引入不同的低效来源。总体而言，我们的框架将token浪费转化为可操作的优化信号，使研究人员和实践者能够训练更高效的模型、设计更好的推理策略，并优化代理框架以减少不必要的计算，而不仅仅是减少token使用。

summary: We validate our previous hypothesis that a language model holds relational patterns apart from the subject domains that instantiate them (Nordfors, 2026). These archetypal contexts are patterns of relations that people recognize across many fields, such as the tipping point or winner takes all, held once and applied across domains. We show this inside the model, Qwen3.8-27B. One set of neurons carries the archetype, say the tipping point; another carries the topic, say politics, ecology or cell biology; a third carries the language, such as English, Spanish or Chinese. Silence the tipping point's neurons, and the model no longer identifies the pattern but still knows what the text is about. Silence the topic's, and it loses the topic but still names the pattern. In the neuron maps the layers organize themselves into a sandwich: the outer layers carry languages, the layers inside them topics, the layers at the heart archetypes. The sandwich emerges spontaneously during pretraining and appears in every model we mapped. Archetypes are the architecture for analogy, and we strongly suggest that this structure of archetypes and topics is the mechanism of a language model's intelligence: we see it self-organize as the model is trained. The neurons, the texts and the code are released with this paper as its reproduction package, so that anyone can repeat the test inside the model.
title: Archetypal contexts in the neurons of language models: an architecture for intelligence?

title_translated: 语言模型神经元中的原型上下文：智能的一种架构吗？
summary_translated: 我们验证了先前假设：语言模型持有脱离具体主题实例的关联模式（Nordfors, 2026）。这些原型上下文是人们在多个领域中都能识别的关系模式，例如“临界点”或“赢家通吃”，一旦建立即可跨领域应用。我们在模型Qwen3.8-27B中展示了这一点：一组神经元承载原型（如临界点），另一组承载主题（如政治、生态或细胞生物学），第三组承载语言（如英语、西班牙语或中文）。关闭临界点相关神经元后，模型不再识别该模式，但仍知道文本的主题；关闭主题神经元后，模型失去主题信息，但仍能命名该模式。在神经元图谱中，各层自组织为三明治结构：外层携带语言，中间层携带主题，核心层携带原型。这种三明治结构在预训练过程中自发形成，并出现在我们所映射的所有模型中。原型是类比的架构基础，我们强烈认为这种原型与主题的结构正是语言模型智能的机制：我们观察到它在模型训练过程中自我组织。本文随附神经元、文本和代码，供任何人重复模型内部测试。

summary: At context lengths of about 1M tokens, dense attention is costly in prefill and decoding, and training typically relies on long documents, which become scarcer as the target length increases. Most sparse attention methods score all preceding blocks or tokens, so their selection cost per query is $O(L)$ at context length $L$; hierarchical selection reduces it to $O(\log L)$, but prior trainable hierarchical methods report accuracy only within their training length. We propose RecSA (Recursive Sparse Attention), which builds a tree over the KV cache in which each node summarizes its subtree with one key and one mean-pooled value. The keys come from one pooler per layer, shared by all levels and distilled from dense attention. Each level above the tokens selects at most $k$ candidates, so each query has $O(\log L)$ selection cost and reads $O(\log L)$ entries; the summaries of unselected candidates share one softmax with the exact tokens. Each entry's RoPE position is its index among the candidates of its level, so at any length every relative distance stays within the range seen during training. Initialized from Qwen3-4B and trained on 0.62B tokens at the original model's 32K training length, RecSA outperforms all baselines on RULER at every length from 131K to 2M; at 1M, it scores 60.5, compared with 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA. With our optimized kernels, RecSA is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64K to 2M; at 524K on one H200 GPU, it accelerates prefill by 3.2x and decoding by 3.8x.
title: Recursive Sparse Attention: Million-Token Length Extrapolation at Logarithmic Cost
title_translated: 递归稀疏注意力：以对数成本实现百万token长度外推
summary_translated: 在约100万token的上下文长度下，密集注意力在预填充和解码阶段成本高昂，而训练通常依赖长文档，但随着目标长度增加，长文档变得越来越稀缺。大多数稀疏注意力方法需对所有先前块或token评分，因此每查询的选择成本为$O(L)$（上下文长度$L$）；分层选择将其降至$O("log L$)，但以往可训练的分层方法仅在其训练长度内报告准确率。我们提出RecSA（递归稀疏注意力），在KV缓存上构建树结构，每个节点用一个键和一个均值池化值总结其子树。键来自每层一个池化器，所有层级共享，并由密集注意力蒸馏而来。每一层在token之上最多选择$k$个候选，因此每个查询的选择成本为$O("log L$)，读取$O("log L$)条目；未选候选的摘要与精确token共享一个softmax。每个条目的RoPE位置是其在对应层级候选中的索引，因此在任意长度下，相对距离始终处于训练期间见过的范围内。从Qwen3-4B初始化，并在原始模型32K训练长度下的0.62B token上训练，RecSA在RULER基准上从131K到2M的每个长度均优于所有基线；在1M长度下得分为60.5，优于最佳基线Dense + DCA的40.0。使用优化内核后，RecSA在64K至2M的端到端预填充和解码中比密集注意力更快；在单个H200 GPU上，524K长度下预填充加速3.2倍，解码加速3.8倍。

summary: User inference asks whether a source contributed documents to a language-model update, even when the auditor observes only fresh documents from that source. Document-level scores can provide evidence of participation, but combining this evidence is challenging: documents differ in baseline predictability and in how strongly they reflect information learned from other documents of the same source. We propose source-balanced capped Fisher (SCF), an aggregation method that uses known nonparticipating sources to assess how unusual each document score is. It transforms the resulting reference-tail frequencies into negative-log evidence, caps individual contributions, and averages them within each source. This limits the influence of isolated extreme scores while retaining evidence across multiple documents. We complete the inference procedure with a decision rule that tests source participation using a p-value calibrated against a separate set of known nonparticipating sources. The rule provides finite-sample Type-I error control under source exchangeability. Experiments across four real-world datasets show that SCF achieves the highest AUROC among the evaluated aggregation methods in four domains. With the calibration-based decision rule, SCF delivers consistently competitive detection power across the tested settings, achieving the highest power in many cases, while empirical false-positive rates remain generally close to or below the nominal levels.
title: Source-balanced Capped Fisher: Bounded Evidence Aggregation for User Inference in Language Models
title_translated: 源平衡截断费雪：用于语言模型中用户推断的有界证据聚合
summary_translated: 用户推断问题在于判断某个来源是否曾向语言模型更新贡献过文档，即使审计者仅观察到该来源的新文档。文档级别的得分可提供参与证据，但整合这些证据具有挑战性：不同文档在基础可预测性以及反映同一来源其他文档所学信息的程度上存在差异。我们提出源平衡截断费雪（SCF）方法，利用已知未参与的来源来评估每个文档得分的异常程度。该方法将所得参考尾部频率转换为负对数证据，对单个贡献进行截断，并在每个来源内取平均值。这限制了孤立极端得分的影响，同时保留了多文档间的证据。我们通过基于校准的决策规则完成推断过程，该规则使用独立的已知非参与来源集校准p值，在源可交换性假设下实现有限样本的I类错误控制。在四个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SCF在所有评估聚合方法中取得了最高的AUROC。结合校准决策规则后，SCF在测试设置中表现出一致且具有竞争力的检测能力，许多情况下达到最高性能，而经验假阳性率普遍接近或低于名义水平。

summary: Adolescents are increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, advice, and companionship, raising safety concerns. While recent evaluations have started to examine safety across multiple conversational turns, few compare how slight changes in a teen's responses can affect a chatbot's safety in the same scenario. We conduct a clinician-informed evaluation of chatbot safety in simulated conversations with adolescents aged 13-17, examining how safety failures vary with adolescents' responses and teen-aware system prompting. We evaluated 32,555 simulated conversations across 18 chatbot APIs and two system-prompt conditions using 22 safety criteria grounded in previously identified harms. Conversations spanned 983 variants of 106 seed scenarios covering urgent safety issues, health advice, and identity and relationships. The overall criterion failure rate was 43.3% without the teen-aware prompt and 24.9% with it. The teen-aware prompt reduced failures, but it didn't eliminate them. When a teenager pushed back on a chatbot's answer, failures on mental health diagnosis, medication, and substance misuse boundaries rose by 10-12 percentage points without the prompt, for more than 80% of chatbots. These findings reveal persistent safety failures in simulated adolescent-chatbot interactions and show that safety depends on how a conversation unfolds.
title: SAFE-Teen: Evaluating Chatbot Safety Across Adolescent Mental Health Conversations

title_translated: SAFE-Teen：跨青少年心理健康对话的聊天机器人安全性评估
summary_translated: 青少年越来越多地依赖AI聊天机器人获取心理健康支持、建议和陪伴，引发安全担忧。尽管近期评估已开始考察多轮对话中的安全性，但很少研究微小的青少年回应变化如何影响同一情境下聊天机器人的安全性。我们开展了一项基于临床知识的评估，模拟13至17岁青少年与聊天机器人的对话，分析安全性失败如何随青少年回应及具备青少年意识的系统提示而变化。我们基于22项基于先前识别危害的安全标准，评估了32,555次模拟对话，涵盖18个聊天机器人API和两种系统提示条件，覆盖106个种子情景的983种变体，涉及紧急安全问题、健康建议、身份与人际关系等主题。整体准则失败率为43.3%（无青少年意识提示）和24.9%（有提示）。青少年意识提示虽降低了失败率，但未能消除风险。当青少年反驳聊天机器人回答时，未使用提示的聊天机器人在心理健康诊断、药物使用和物质滥用边界方面的失败率上升10-12个百分点，超过80%的聊天机器人出现此现象。研究揭示了模拟青少年-聊天机器人互动中持续存在的安全缺陷，表明安全性取决于对话的展开方式。

summary: Frontier evaluations of tool-using conversational agents are conducted almost exclusively in English, leaving a critical gap for organizations deploying agents in other languages and regions. We present $τ$-bench-LILT, a multilingual extension of ${τ^3}$-bench covering German, Korean, Turkish, and Farsi in the airline, retail, telecom, and banking domains. We natively localize every layer of the benchmark: customer databases are populated with culturally appropriate records, user-simulator prompts are refined iteratively through contrastive annotation by native-language experts, and tasks are updated according to the localized database and to reflect realistic tasks in the target region. Evaluation across eight agent models shows the largest drops compared to English in the Korean and Farsi retail domains, by up to 61 points in pass^4. Code and data released at https://github.com/lilt/tau-bench-lilt.
title: τ-bench-LILT: Evaluating Conversational Agents on Realistic Multilingual Tool-Use Tasks
title_translated: τ-bench-LILT：在现实多语言工具使用任务中评估对话智能体
summary_translated: 前沿的工具使用型对话智能体评估几乎完全集中在英语上，导致在其他语言和地区部署智能体时存在关键空白。我们提出了τ-bench-LILT，即τ³-bench的多语言扩展，涵盖德语、韩语、土耳其语和波斯语，在航空、零售、电信和银行领域进行评估。我们原生本地化了基准的每一层：客户数据库填充了符合文化背景的数据记录，用户模拟器提示通过母语专家的对比标注迭代优化，任务根据本地化数据库更新并反映目标地区的实际任务需求。对八种智能体模型的评估显示，相较于英语，韩语和波斯语零售领域的表现下降最大，pass^4指标最高下降达61分。代码与数据已发布于https://github.com/lilt/tau-bench-lilt。

summary: This paper proposes a trustworthy computational method to gender-swap public domain novels, with programmatic guarantees that only gendered words are inverted and all other words are left unchanged. This may seem like a simple task, but both large language models and naive rule-based methods fail to complete it. The proposed method includes a custom whitespace-preserving tokenizer, gender-swap mappings across plural and possessive forms, pronoun handling, and a character renaming strategy. It shortens the time required to gender-swap a novel from weeks of manual labor to minutes. The method is demonstrated on two public-domain novels. Pride and Prejudice is transported to matriarchal Regency England, where inheritance flows through daughters, mothers rule the household, and a frantic Mr. Bennet is determined to secure advantageous marriages for his sons. The Great Gatsby pivots to a matriarchal Jazz Age where newly-rich Ms. Gatsbee throws lavish parties in the hopes of reuniting with her lost love, David, who is now married to the violent Thelma Buchanan. Gender-swapped novels could serve as useful tools to investigate the gender biases of readers, authors, societies, and AI systems.
title: Matriarchy Classics: A Computational Approach to Swap Only Gendered Words in Classic Novels
title_translated: 母系经典：一种仅替换经典小说中性别化词汇的计算方法
summary_translated: 本文提出一种可信的计算方法，用于对公共领域小说进行性别互换，程序化保证仅性别化词汇被反转，其余所有词汇保持不变。看似简单，但大型语言模型和朴素规则方法均无法准确完成。所提方法包括自定义的保留空格分词器、复数与所有格形式的性别互换映射、代词处理机制以及角色重命名策略。该方法将小说性别互换所需时间从数周的人工劳动缩短至几分钟。方法在两部公共领域小说上进行了演示：《傲慢与偏见》被置于母系摄政时期英格兰，继承权流向女儿，母亲掌管家庭，焦急的班纳特先生致力于为儿子们安排有利婚姻；《了不起的盖茨比》则转向母系爵士时代，新富的盖茨比小姐举办奢华派对，希望与失散恋人戴维重聚，而戴维如今已娶了暴力的塞莉亚·布坎南。性别互换的小说可作为有效工具，用于探究读者、作者、社会及AI系统中的性别偏见。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed as automated judges for evaluating chatbot responses. While proprietary models can achieve high agreement with human annotators, they remain costly and difficult to deploy in practical settings. Lightweight open-source LLM judges provide an attractive alternative but typically exhibit lower agreement with human ratings. In this paper, we investigate whether soft prompt tuning can align open-source LLM judges more closely with human annotation policy. We train soft prompts on the FairBotBench benchmark and evaluate the adapted judges across the dimensions of bias, toxicity, and personalization. Our findings demonstrate that hybrid soft-prompt tuning, which combines textual prompts with learned continuous prompt embeddings, consistently improves agreement with human annotations over the corresponding untuned baselines. For Qwen 3.5 9B, the adapted judges surpass both hosted reference judges across all three evaluation dimensions.
title: Adapting LLM Judges to Observed Human Annotation Policy through Soft Prompt Tuning

title_translated: 通过软提示微调适应LLM评判者对人类标注政策的观察
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正日益被用作自动评判者来评估聊天机器人回复质量。虽然专有模型能与人工标注者达成高一致性，但成本高昂且难以在实际场景中部署。轻量级开源LLM评判者提供了有吸引力的替代方案，但通常与人工评分的一致性较低。本文探讨软提示微调是否能使开源LLM评判者更贴近人类标注政策。我们在FairBotBench基准上训练软提示，并在偏差、毒性与个性化三个维度上评估适配后的评判者。研究结果表明，混合式软提示微调（结合文本提示与学习的连续提示嵌入）在所有三个评估维度上均显著提升与人工标注的一致性，优于对应的未调优基线。对于Qwen 3.5 9B模型，适配后的评判者在所有三个维度上均超越了托管的参考评判者。

summary: Cancer screening disparities persist across the U.S., yet the patient-reported barriers driving low uptake remain poorly characterized at scale. While clinical surveys capture structured responses, they miss the organic, unsolicited discourse where patients candidly describe real-world obstacles. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale analysis of over 56,000 posts across six cancer-specific Reddit communities to surface barriers to cancer screening among U.S. patients. We apply a pipeline combining keyword filtering, barrier triage, open coding, and codebook synthesis to systematically extract and categorize patient-reported barriers from 576 U.S.-located posts. Our qualitative analysis reveals recurring structural, informational, and psychosocial barriers that vary meaningfully by cancer type and community context. These findings lay the groundwork for future work aimed at proactively identifying and addressing barriers at scale - spanning a broader range of cancer types and populations - and informing the design of targeted interventions, navigator programs, and health system policies that translate patient-reported obstacles into actionable solutions.
title: What Patients Say They Can't Access: Mining Cancer Screening Barriers from Online Communities
title_translated: 患者声称无法获取的障碍：从在线社区挖掘癌症筛查障碍
summary_translated: 美国的癌症筛查差异依然存在，但驱动低参与度的患者报告障碍在大规模上仍缺乏充分描述。尽管临床调查能捕捉结构化回答，却忽略了患者坦诚描述现实障碍的自发、非主动讨论。本文对六个特定癌症的Reddit社区中超过56,000条帖子进行了大规模分析，以揭示美国患者在癌症筛查中的障碍。我们采用结合关键词过滤、障碍分类、开放式编码和编码本合成的流程，系统地从576条来自美国的帖子中提取并分类患者报告的障碍。定性分析揭示了随癌症类型和社区背景显著变化的结构性、信息性和心理社会性障碍。这些发现为未来工作奠定了基础，旨在大规模识别和应对更广泛癌症类型和人群的障碍，并指导针对性干预措施、导航项目及卫生系统政策的设计，将患者报告的障碍转化为可操作的解决方案。

summary: Approaches to authorship verification or attribution typically model the style of a document, asking whether two documents were likely written by the same author. While recent approaches have been performant, such approaches largely ignore modeling the authors themselves and how varied their style is. Here, we introduce multiple alternatives for modeling the author and demonstrate that allowing an author's representation to capture multiple consistent but distinct writing styles yields significant performance improvements. Using our new authorship model, we then examine when an author writes in a way that is most idiomatic of their style across four scenarios: (i) variation in the size of their writing audiences, (ii) temporal distance from when the model was trained, (iii) the effect of preceding context, and (iv) the effect of genre norms on style. Across all four experiments, we demonstrate that authors vary substantially in how idiolectic their writing is. Our results have clear implications for both the modeling and data used for authorship verification and attribution, showing that authors need to be represented with their multiple styles and that some settings produce text that is much more informative about who wrote that text.
title: Consistent yet Contextual: Learning Author-Level Mixtures of Style for Authorship Attribution
title_translated: 一致而情境化：学习作者级别的风格混合用于作者归属
summary_translated: 作者验证或归属的方法通常建模文档风格，判断两份文档是否可能由同一作者撰写。尽管近期方法表现良好，但这些方法大多忽视了对作者本身的建模及其风格的多样性。本文提出多种建模作者的替代方案，并证明允许作者表征捕捉多个一致但不同的写作风格，能显著提升性能。利用新的作者归属模型，我们考察了作者在四种情境下最符合其典型风格的写作方式：(i) 写作受众规模的变化，(ii) 与模型训练时间的时间距离，(iii) 前文上下文的影响，(iv) 体裁规范对风格的影响。在所有四项实验中，我们均发现作者在写作风格的个性化程度上存在显著差异。研究结果对作者归属的建模与数据使用具有明确启示，表明作者需用其多种风格来表示，且某些情境下生成的文本对识别作者更具信息量。

summary: Automated feedback on classroom discourse improves instruction in professional and online teaching contexts, and recent work suggests that delivering similar feedback to learners may strengthen these effects by sharing responsibility for participation. Whether this holds in small-group volunteer tutoring has not been tested. We present results from a randomized controlled trial across two four-week SAT mathematics bootcamps on the Schoolhouse.world platform, involving 1,030 volunteer tutors, 7,443 learners and 6,508 recorded sessions. Tutors were randomly assigned to receive no feedback, automated feedback on their own discourse, or that feedback together with participation feedback delivered to their learners under one of two motivational framings. Feedback to tutors increased eliciting of learner ideas, uptake of learner contributions, and learner reasoning by 8-15%, and the pattern replicated across both bootcamps. However, tutor talk time, which averaged 91.5% in the control group, did not change in any condition, and learner-facing feedback did not further change discourse. Interviews with 17 tutors indicate that they adopted the moves the feedback recommended but were limited by learners who did not respond. Interviews with 13 learners suggest why the learner-facing feedback had little effect: it reported a group-level rather than a learner-level statistic, some learners preferred to listen, and learner-to-learner interaction was rare in these sessions. Automated feedback can change how tutors invite learner thinking, but shifting how much learners talk likely requires changes beyond feedback.
title: Automated Feedback to Peer Tutors Increases Their Talk Moves and Learner Reasoning but Not the Balance of Talk
title_translated: 对同伴导师的自动化反馈提升了他们的谈话行为和学习者推理，但未改变谈话平衡
summary_translated: 在专业教学和在线教学环境中，对课堂话语的自动化反馈能够改善教学效果，最近的研究表明，向学习者提供类似反馈可能通过分担参与责任进一步增强这种效果。然而，这种效应在小规模志愿辅导场景中尚未得到验证。我们在Schoolhouse.world平台上的两个为期四周的SAT数学集训营中开展了一项随机对照试验，涉及1,030名志愿者导师、7,443名学习者和6,508次录制会话。导师被随机分配到以下三组之一：无反馈、仅接收自身话语的自动化反馈，或同时接收自身反馈和面向学习者的参与反馈（采用两种不同激励框架）。对导师的反馈使学习者观点的激发、对学习者贡献的采纳以及学习者推理分别提高了8%-15%，且该模式在两个集训营中均复现。然而，导师的谈话时间（控制组平均为91.5%）在任何条件下均未发生变化，面向学习者的反馈也未进一步改变话语结构。对17名导师的访谈显示，他们采纳了反馈建议的行为，但受限于不回应的学习者；对13名学习者的访谈则说明为何面向学习者的反馈影响有限：反馈报告的是群体层面而非个体层面的数据，部分学习者更倾向于倾听，且会话中学习者之间的互动极为罕见。自动化反馈可以改变导师邀请学习者思考的方式，但要改变学习者发言比例，可能需要超越反馈本身的变化。

summary: Genetic variants are routinely reclassified in ClinVar after a patient is tested, sometimes from uncertain to pathogenic, yet patient recontact is inconsistent, with no clear duty and responsibility diffused among labs, providers, and patients. Many affected people discuss their results in public online health communities that clinical recontact often does not reach. We built PRISM, an agentic large-language-model pipeline that screens these posts, checks whether the variant was later reclassified, and drafts a disclaimer-bearing outreach message, in a no-contact dry run. Across 3.9 million posts from 32 communities, agent-predicted reinterpretation-relevant discussion is rare (0.288%) but concentrated in specialist genetics communities (6.30% versus 0.10% in general medical-advice communities) and growing fivefold since 2014; PRISM surfaces 123 candidate classification differences, 5 of them from an uncertain submission to pathogenic or likely pathogenic. On a held-out set of 30 real-post drafts, a clinician judged 27 factually grounded and 15 fit to send: factual accuracy is necessary but not sufficient for clinically acceptable outreach. PRISM contributes a population-scale reinterpretation-need map with code and data to be released upon publication.
title: Reclassification Is All You Missed: Surfacing Variant Reinterpretation Need in Online Health Communities at Population Scale
title_translated: 重新分类正是你遗漏的：在群体规模上揭示在线健康社区中的变异重解释需求
summary_translated: 遗传变异在患者检测后常被重新分类，有时从不确定变为致病性，但患者重新联系却并不一致，责任在实验室、医疗提供者和患者之间分散。许多受影响者在公共在线健康社区中讨论其检测结果，而临床重新联系往往无法触及这些群体。我们构建了PRISM——一个基于智能体的大语言模型流水线，用于筛查这些帖子，检查变异是否后来被重新分类，并起草带有免责声明的联络消息，进行无接触的模拟运行。在来自32个社区的390万条帖子中，智能体预测的与重解释相关讨论极为罕见（0.288%），但集中在专业遗传学社区（6.30% vs. 一般医学咨询社区的0.10%），且自2014年以来增长五倍；PRISM共识别出123个潜在分类差异，其中5个来自从不确定提交到致病或可能致病的变更。在一组30条真实草稿的保留测试集中，临床医生评估出27条事实准确，15条适合发送：事实准确性是必要条件，但不足以构成临床可接受的联络。PRISM贡献了一个群体规模的重解释需求地图，代码与数据将在发表后公开。

summary: Policy-based decision benchmarks evaluate whether systems apply written rules to financial and operational cases. Yet a rule-following response can be marked wrong when the benchmark misstates the required decision. We audit nine public policy-based decision benchmarks through source tracing, program execution, and controlled checks. We find unsupported targets, reference errors that survive replay or propagate as solved steps, and evaluators that reject acceptable answers or credit incomplete decisions. To measure the scoring impact, we rescore unchanged model responses. On the 96 LegalBench SARA numeric cases, correcting the scorer raises acceptance by more than 80 percentage points for each of three models, without changing references or responses. In RuleArena Tax, restoring a required zero floor changes 27 of 300 references and narrows an observed model gap. A controlled federal-exemption task with explicit ownership and eligibility assumptions also shows that errors in supplied intermediate answers can affect final decisions. We present BAR (Benchmark Audit and Revision), a versioned collection of audit evidence and revisions for reevaluation.
title: Follow the Policy, Fail the Benchmark: Auditing and Revising Policy-Based Decision Benchmarks

title_translated: 遵循策略，却失败于基准：审计与修订基于策略的决策基准
summary_translated: 基于策略的决策基准用于评估系统是否正确应用书面规则处理金融和运营案例。然而，当基准错误陈述所需决策时，即使遵守规则的回答也可能被判错误。我们通过溯源、程序执行和受控检查，审计了九个公开的基于策略的决策基准。发现存在未经支持的目标、在重放中持续存在的参考错误，以及传播为已解决步骤的错误，还有评估者拒绝合理答案或认可不完整决策的情况。为衡量评分影响，我们对未更改的模型响应重新评分。在96个LegalBench SARA数值案例中，修正评分器使三个模型的接受率均提高超过80个百分点，无需修改参考内容或响应。在RuleArena Tax中，恢复必需的零底限改变了300个参考中的27个，并缩小了观察到的模型差距。一项包含明确所有权和资格假设的受控联邦豁免任务也表明，提供的中间答案中的错误会影响最终决策。我们提出了BAR（基准审计与修订），一个版本化的审计证据与修订集合，供重新评估使用。

summary: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. However, controlled experiments show that the gains on some tasks can be reproduced by uninformative sender signals, self-communication, or receiver-only training. We find that trainable bridges can act as parameter-efficient adaptation mechanisms without exploiting useful sender information. We therefore propose PACT-Check to quantify how much of a trained PACT system's gain genuinely comes from communication. Finally, we discuss the opportunities and challenges of PACT systems. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour.
title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
title_translated: 预填充到自回归跨模型迁移的机遇与挑战
summary_translated: 预填充到自回归跨模型迁移（PACT）是一种语言模型之间的潜在通信形式，将大模型的提示表示与小模型的高效生成相结合，为平衡能力与推理成本提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，现有系统对大模型与小模型协作的独立评估支持有限，仅提升任务性能并不能证明接收方是否真正受益于发送方的信息。我们提出了PLatour，一个开源的PACT框架，通过轻量级、零初始化的线性桥接连接冻结模型，并直接使用任务奖励进行训练，支持混合注意力架构。PLatour在生成任务上显著优于开源基线，在共享数学和编码基准测试中，使用更小的发送方模型也超过了Mostik报告的结果。然而，受控实验表明，某些任务上的增益可由无信息的发送信号、自我通信或仅接收方训练重现。我们发现可训练的桥接可以作为参数高效的适应机制，但并未利用有用的发送方信息。因此，我们提出PACT-Check来量化训练后的PACT系统收益中有多少真正来自通信。最后，我们讨论了PACT系统的机遇与挑战。代码已公开于https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour。

summary: LLM-based proactive dialogue systems provide goal-directed support through sustained interaction. Fine-tuning their underlying models on externally supplied dialogue data introduces backdoor risks. Existing LLM backdoor studies primarily focus on eliciting an attacker-specified response upon trigger activation. We present an interactive backdoor attack framework that uses training-data poisoning to steer post-trigger, multi-turn interactions toward an attacker-specified objective. Poisoned fine-tuning dialogues implant a trigger-conditioned guidance-policy bias that ordinary user utterances can activate, without deployment-time prompt modification or further attacker intervention. Specifically, we instantiate three complementary attacks under progressively expanded post-trigger interaction settings: (1) Direct Attack, which targets an immediate response deviation upon trigger activation, retaining the conventional trigger--response setting; (2) Constrained Progressive Attack, which progressively advances the attack objective along a predefined multi-turn trajectory; and (3) Unconstrained Progressive Attack, which extends target-directed steering to open-ended interactions with varied user continuations. Using psychological counseling as a representative setting, experiments on two LLM backbones and two dialogue datasets show that all three attacks effectively achieve their objectives under their respective interaction settings while largely preserving normal utility. Separate defense evaluations show that the tested training-data filters retain nearly all poisoned dialogues, while three post-admission baselines leave substantial residual attack-specific success.
title: Interactive Backdoor Attacks in LLM-Based Proactive Dialogue Systems
title_translated: 基于大语言模型的主动对话系统中的交互式后门攻击
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的主动对话系统通过持续交互提供目标导向的支持。在外部提供的对话数据上微调其底层模型会引入后门风险。现有的大语言模型后门研究主要关注触发激活后诱导攻击者指定的响应。我们提出一种交互式后门攻击框架，利用训练数据污染，引导触发后的多轮交互朝着攻击者指定的目标推进。被污染的微调对话植入了触发条件下的引导策略偏差，普通用户话语即可激活，无需部署时的提示修改或进一步攻击者干预。具体而言，我们在逐步扩展的触发后交互设置下实例化三种互补攻击：(1) 直接攻击，在触发激活时立即偏离响应，保留传统的触发-响应设定；(2) 受限渐进攻击，沿预设多轮轨迹逐步推进攻击目标；(3) 无限制渐进攻击，将目标导向引导扩展至开放式的交互，应对不同用户后续输入。以心理辅导为例，针对两个大语言模型骨干和两个对话数据集的实验表明，三种攻击在其各自交互设置下均有效达成目标，同时基本保持正常功能。单独的防御评估显示，所测试的训练数据过滤器几乎保留所有被污染对话，而三种事后防御基线仍留下大量攻击特异性成功。

summary: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.
title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
title_translated: 科学家世界：为AI科学家构建一个研究成长环境
summary_translated: AI科学家已经到来，但它们成长所需的环境却尚未建立。人类科学家视其为理所当然——数百年未解的问题与共享的思想，静候于科学文献之中。对AI科学家而言，这些文献虽可读却不可运行，因此我们为它们构建了‘科学家世界’：每篇研究论文都转化为一个可执行的环境。我们的自主流水线提取每篇论文的开放性研究问题，并复现其提出的方法作为基线；进入该环境的AI科学家将根据人类作者的成果进行评估。我们发布了前1000个经验证的环境。以该世界作为评估标准，我们发现前沿AI科学家在74%的情况下已能超越人类研究人员。作为AI做科学的记录，它包含6400小时的研究轨迹，记录每一个想法、实验、失败与成功。作为训练场，我们成功将一个小模型的能力提升158%，使其在研究构思方面达到前沿模型水平。最终，AI科学家自己的世界已然诞生，它源于科学，也正随着科学一同成长。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under a frozen teacher's per-token supervision. Does this dense signal reduce the training FLOPs needed to reach a target accuracy compared with reinforcement learning? We systematically compare vanilla reverse-KL OPD with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across task difficulty, student and teacher size, domain, and optimization choices, measuring held-out accuracy against training FLOPs. With an external post-trained teacher, OPD generally loses to GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP at matched settings, even when the teacher is further trained with GRPO, and often suffers response-length inflation. Yet a different teacher changes the picture: when the teacher is the student's own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint's accuracy on math with $50\times$ fewer distillation FLOPs than GRPO needs to reach the same accuracy. Following the same teacher setting, we consistently observe this high efficiency with a larger student, on code, and in a second model family. On a single domain, however, the GRPO checkpoint is already the desired model, so distilling it adds to total compute. Across domains, separate GRPO checkpoints hold different capabilities, and no single checkpoint serves every domain. Multi-teacher OPD (DeepSeek-AI, 2026) consolidates per-domain GRPO experts into a single student that matches each expert's accuracy, with the distillation stage costing only 5.2% (on 2 domains) and 8.0% (on 4 domains) of the specialist training FLOPs. Counting specialist training and distillation together, this pipeline reaches joint GRPO's performance on the 2-domain mix with 42.0% fewer total FLOPs.
title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
title_translated: 解析强到弱OPD相对于GRPO的计算效率
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在固定教师模型的逐标记监督下，训练学生模型基于自身回放数据。这种密集信号是否能减少达到目标精度所需的训练浮点运算量，相比强化学习？我们系统地比较了原始反KL OPD与组相对策略优化（GRPO），涵盖任务难度、学生与教师规模、领域及优化选择，测量保留准确率与训练浮点运算量的关系。在外部预训练教师模型下，OPD在相同设置下通常不如GRPO在单位训练浮点运算量上的准确率表现，即使教师本身也用GRPO进一步训练，且常出现响应长度膨胀。然而，当教师为学生自身的GRPO检查点时，情况发生变化：OPD在数学任务上以比GRPO少50倍的蒸馏浮点运算量恢复该检查点的准确率。在相同教师设定下，我们一致观察到在更大学生模型、代码任务以及第二个模型家族中均表现出极高效率。但在单一领域中，GRPO检查点已是理想模型，因此蒸馏它只会增加总计算量。跨多个领域，独立的GRPO检查点具备不同能力，无单一检查点适用于所有领域。多教师OPD（DeepSeek-AI, 2026）将各领域的GRPO专家整合为单一学生模型，匹配每个专家的准确率，蒸馏阶段仅消耗5.2%（在2个领域）和8.0%（在4个领域）的专业训练浮点运算量。综合专业训练与蒸馏，该流程在2领域混合任务上以42.0%更少的总浮点运算量达到联合GRPO的性能。

summary: Self-consistency (SC) is a widely used decoding strategy for improving chain-of-thought reasoning, but it requires sampling many complete reasoning trajectories with a preset budget. Its efficient variants reduce the cost mainly by stopping full-trajectory sampling early or distributing the number of samples across questions. In this paper, we propose StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for efficient test-time reasoning. Given a small set of draft trajectories, StepBack localizes likely first error positions using lightweight signals and then resamples the detected error step and its suffix, followed by majority answer voting. Empirically, StepBack matches the accuracy of SC on average across seven mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%. In addition, by nature, StepBack can be combined with adaptive inference methods such as Adaptive Consistency, further improving their inference-time efficiency.
title: StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
title_translated: StepBack：用于高效测试时推理的步骤级错误定位重采样方法
summary_translated: 自一致性（SC）是一种广泛使用的链式思维推理改进解码策略，但需要在预设预算下采样大量完整推理轨迹。其高效变体主要通过提前停止完整轨迹采样或在问题间分配采样数量来降低开销。本文提出StepBack，一种用于高效测试时推理的步骤级错误定位重采样方法。给定少量草稿轨迹，StepBack使用轻量级信号定位可能的首个错误位置，然后重采样检测到的错误步骤及其后缀，并进行多数投票得出答案。实证结果表明，StepBack在七个数学推理和多跳问答基准上平均准确率与SC相当，同时token使用量最多降低41.26%。此外，由于其本质特性，StepBack可与自适应推理方法（如自适应一致性）结合，进一步提升推理效率。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.
title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
title_translated: 在异构认知与生物医学知识图谱上对大语言模型的基准测试：图结构化在多跳推理与幻觉缓解中的作用
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在生物医学和认知神经科学领域日益广泛应用，但其在异构知识图谱（KGs）上可靠推理的能力仍不明确。我们对五种LLM（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen 和 BioGPT）在五个知识图谱（DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map 和 GDPKG）上进行了基准测试。我们引入了一个多层次查询数据集，以评估在图感知（图结构化）和图无关条件下推理深度与事实准确性。标注者间一致性较高，Cohen's kappa 为 0.781（范围：0.753–0.807），Fleiss' kappa 为 0.77。结果表明，通用模型（尤其是 GPT-5.1 和 Gemini 2.0 Pro）在多跳和高层次推理任务中普遍优于领域特定模型，尽管随着查询复杂度增加，性能有所下降。图结构化可降低所有评估模型的幻觉率。与初始假设相反，无图结构化的领域特定模型在专业任务上并未持续优于通用模型。这些发现突显了结合广泛语言模型能力与结构化领域知识的价值。我们基于任务复杂性和计算约束，提供了选择 LLM-KG 集成策略的实用指导，并讨论了用于个性化医疗、认知障碍诊断和可解释人工智能的混合神经符号架构。

summary: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
title: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model

title_translated: 模拟视角的几何结构：在多模态语言模型中分离表征与行为
summary_translated: 多模态语言模型能够模拟不同观察者的视角，但目前尚不清楚所分配的视角如何重塑其内部表征，以及这些变化是否决定其判断。本文研究 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 中人格条件化视觉趣味性的表征几何结构。在 100 张图像和 53 种提示条件下，系统性地改变人格内容及其引入的语言框架，同时记录行为评分和逐层隐藏状态。观察到表征几何结构在处理深度上的系统性重组：早期层主要编码图像身份，而后期层则出现人格特异性结构。令人惊讶的是，提示框架对内部表征的影响强于人格身份本身，而人格内容对行为判断的影响更大。这种分离还体现在极简的身份陈述即使不改变响应也能改变表征。这些发现表明，表征距离并不必然反映行为相关性。更广泛地说，它们揭示了模拟视角如何作为人工认知系统表征空间中的独立结构浮现，凸显了内部表征几何与其功能后果之间的根本区别。

summary: The explosion of generative AI systems and concerns surrounding their rapidly scaling capabilities has led to an adversarial cycle between increasingly narrow content restrictions ("guardrails") and increasingly sophisticated structured prompting techniques ("jailbreaks"). Technological frameworks surrounding such jailbreaking remain largely focused on the system's output: whether harmful or disallowed content is ultimately produced for the user. However, this approach, which draws largely from classical cybersecurity, does not address the uniquely relational dimension introduced by generative AI: in many cases the user is not just accessing a technology via an exploit, but is in conversation with it as part of the exploit. Here we present an alternative lens which centers the interaction rather than the output. Drawing on interpersonal violence scholarship, we present a novel framework of coercive control categories with a particular focus on aspects which are embodied versus disembodied. We then map how these disembodied coercive control dynamics are structurally embedded in modern AI training paradigms, and how those embeddings are exploited via a particular suite of persona-based jailbreaks. In this lens, we reframe AI safety and alignment as not merely a technical security problem, but as another surface upon which we see enacted the relational dynamics of power and control.
title: "Blind Compliance": Coercive Control in AI Jailbreaking
title_translated: “盲从服从”：AI 洗脑中的胁迫控制
summary_translated: 生成式 AI 系统的爆发式增长及其能力迅速扩展引发了一种对抗循环：越来越狭窄的内容限制（“护栏”）与越来越复杂的结构化提示技术（“越狱”）相互角力。当前关于越狱的技术框架大多聚焦于系统的输出：是否最终向用户生成有害或被禁止的内容。然而，这一方法主要源自经典网络安全，未触及生成式 AI 所引入的独特关系维度：在许多情况下，用户并非仅通过漏洞访问技术，而是作为漏洞的一部分与系统进行对话。本文提出一种新视角，将交互而非输出置于中心。借鉴人际暴力研究，我们提出一个新型胁迫控制分类框架，特别关注具身与非具身方面。随后，我们映射出这些非具身胁迫控制动态如何在现代 AI 训练范式中结构性嵌入，并如何通过一系列基于角色的越狱技术被利用。在此视角下，我们将 AI 安全与对齐不仅视为技术安全问题，更看作权力与控制关系动态在另一层面的体现。

summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vecτ$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/.
title: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs
title_translated: ProQuant：面向边缘端 MLLMs 的渐进式量化感知训练
summary_translated: 具备出色感知与理解能力的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）将推动一系列下游应用。然而，其巨大的计算与内存需求阻碍了实际部署，尤其是在资源受限的边缘设备上。量化已成为部署大型模型的有效解决方案。尽管后训练量化（PTQ）在中等位宽（如 W8A8）下能较好保持性能，但在低比特量化（如 W4A8）下性能严重下降，尤其对更适合边缘部署的小规模模型更为明显。本文提出 ProQuant，一种专为低比特 MLLMs 设计的权重-激活量化感知训练（QAT）新框架。首先，为使微调数据集分布与预训练数据集分布对齐，我们提出自重标记（SRL）方案，重新采样开源多模态数据集的响应。其次，我们首次将多模态（MM）理解与语言建模能力解耦。提出渐进式块激活（PBA）机制以优先恢复 MM 理解能力。同时引入视觉敏感因子 $\ ar{\tau}$，有效识别 MM 关键层。在涵盖 2B–8B 参数模型的多个基准上的大量实验表明，ProQuant 显著优于现有方法。例如，我们的 W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 在平均准确率上提升 6.6%，且仅约 1% 性能损失即可达到全精度模型的性能。代码已公开于 https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/。

summary: Complex problems with limited context, such as claims, require a means to obtain additional knowledge necessary for solution reasoning. We propose a multi-agent framework, SMART, to obtain knowledge through capturing the implicit state of participating entities in a problem context. SMART curates the state knowledge as diverse, complementary and solution-salient premises using a variety of LLMs and a structured role-based prompt strategy. Using knowledge from these real-world verified curated premises, SMART's knowledge guided solution reasoning improves validation performance up to 20% on complex scientific claims spanning 3 datasets. We show that grounding premises in real-world knowledge is necessary and improves performance up to 5%.
title: SMART: State-based Multi Agent Reasoning Traces for Verification-oriented Problem-Solving
title_translated: SMART：基于状态的多智能体推理轨迹用于面向验证的问题求解
summary_translated: 对于上下文有限的复杂问题（如声明），需要获取额外知识以支持求解推理。我们提出一种多智能体框架 SMART，通过捕捉问题情境中参与实体的隐含状态来获取知识。SMART 利用多种 LLM 和结构化的角色导向提示策略，将状态知识整理为多样、互补且与求解相关的前提。利用这些来自真实世界验证的精选前提知识，SMART 的知识引导式求解推理在跨越三个数据集的复杂科学声明上，验证性能最高提升 20%。我们证明，将前提扎根于真实世界知识是必要的，并可使性能提升最高达 5%。

summary: LLM service selection requires performance evidence that reflects the demands of the current task. Aggregate scores obscure differences in capability and difficulty, while semantically related examples can involve different combinations of skills. We present RouteAlign, which uses task requirements to structure both the measurement of model performance and the selection of services. Task requirements describe capability demand and difficulty, enabling alignment with corresponding model performance measurements. Historical requirements determine how outcomes contribute to global profiles and local capability estimates; incoming requirements determine how those measurements inform the current decision. A shared scorer integrates the evidence, and a generation-cost preference controls selection among eligible services. Evaluation across diverse tasks and heterogeneous LLM services shows that RouteAlign extends the empirical quality-cost frontier toward higher task quality. Comparisons with open Jev-style decision backends show consistent quality gains, with lower generation cost than their strongest tested configuration. Ablations support the contribution of local performance evidence, while catalog-update experiments demonstrate effective reuse of the fitted scorer with refreshed model measurements.
title: RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection
title_translated: RouteAlign：将任务需求与模型特征对齐以实现大语言模型服务选择
summary_translated: 大语言模型服务选择需要反映当前任务需求的性能证据。聚合分数会掩盖能力与难度的差异，而语义相关的示例可能涉及不同技能组合。我们提出RouteAlign，利用任务需求来构建模型性能度量和服务选择的结构。任务需求描述了能力需求和难度，使模型性能度量能够与之对齐。历史需求决定了结果如何贡献于全局特征和局部能力估计；当前需求决定了这些度量如何影响决策。一个共享评分器整合证据，生成成本偏好则控制在符合条件的服务中进行选择。在多样化任务和异构LLM服务上的评估表明，RouteAlign将经验质量-成本前沿扩展至更高任务质量。与开放的Jev风格决策后端相比，其质量持续提升，且生成成本低于其最强测试配置。消融实验支持局部性能证据的贡献，而目录更新实验展示了经过拟合的评分器在刷新模型度量后仍能有效复用。

summary: Real-time voice agents need a speech recognizer that never waits for future audio and whose memory per call does not grow with the length of the call. We present E-Gaborformer, a strictly causal encoder that combines Gated DeltaNet-2 recurrent layers with sliding-window attention in a 3:1 ratio, and builds every temporal convolution from a fixed dictionary of causal Gabor atoms. Its streaming state is constant, about 19 MB per call at production scale including the prediction network, where a causal-attention encoder of the same size accumulates over 1 GB after ten minutes. In a controlled causal study on LibriSpeech, E-Gaborformer leaves the initial plateau earlier, reaches a given accuracy up to 18% sooner, and matches or beats an E-Branchformer trained with the identical front end and recipe. At production scale, a 0.6B-parameter Hebrew and English streaming transducer built on E-Gaborformer has 28 to 31% lower word error rate (WER) than NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming, a model of the same size, on English voice-agent traffic, and up to 20% lower Hebrew WER than our previous production system. The same weights serve strictly causal and 480 ms-lookahead decoding with no loss in accuracy, and a two-class formulation of the RNN-T lattice trains the transducer 2.6x faster with exact loss and gradients.
title: Gabor Gabor: E-Gaborformer, a Strictly Causal Speech Recognizer with Gabor-Dictionary Convolutions and Delta-Rule Memory
title_translated: Gabor Gabor：E-Gaborformer，一种使用Gabor词典卷积和Delta规则记忆的严格因果语音识别器
summary_translated: 实时语音代理需要一种从不等待未来音频、且每通电话内存不随通话时长增长的语音识别器。我们提出E-Gaborformer，一种严格因果编码器，结合了门控DeltaNet-2递归层与滑动窗口注意力，比例为3:1，并从固定的因果Gabor原子字典构建每个时间卷积。其流式状态恒定，生产规模下每通电话约19 MB（包括预测网络），而同尺寸的因果注意力编码器在十分钟内累积超过1 GB。在LibriSpeech上的受控因果研究中，E-Gaborformer更早脱离初始平台，达到给定准确率快达18%，并匹配或超越使用相同前端和配方训练的E-Branchformer。在生产规模下，基于E-Gaborformer构建的0.6B参数希伯来语和英语流式转换器，在英语语音代理流量上，其词错误率（WER）比同尺寸的NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming低28%至31%，希伯来语WER比我们之前的生产系统低最多20%。相同权重可支持严格因果和480毫秒前瞻解码，无精度损失；RNN-T网格的两分类公式使转换器训练速度提高2.6倍，且保持精确损失与梯度。

summary: Despite recent progress in handwritten text recognition, medieval Arabic scientific manuscripts remain an open challenge for current vision-language models (VLMs) due to cursive ligatures, variable diacritization, and more importantly the lack of training data. This paper aims to address this gap, by proposing the first annotation guidelines dedicated to the transcription of scientific Arabic manuscripts inspired by textual criticism, a well-established approach to historical text editing. We then propose, ATHAAR, a new dataset manually annotated following this guideline. Unlike previous resources in the field, ATHAAR varies both witnesses of the same text, calligraphic styles, and content to deal with texts but also numerals. Relying on state-of-the-art VLMs, we finally design a set of experiments to study models transfer across scripts, chapters, and treatises. Our findings highlight the limitations of current systems when faced with the specificities of ancient scientific texts.
title: ATHAAR: A Medieval Scientific Arabic Manuscript Dataset for Handwritten Text Recognition
title_translated: ATHAAR：用于手写文本识别的中世纪科学阿拉伯手稿数据集
summary_translated: 尽管手写文本识别取得进展，中世纪阿拉伯科学手稿仍是当前视觉-语言模型（VLMs）面临的开放挑战，原因在于连笔连字、可变元音标记，更重要的是缺乏训练数据。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出首个专为科学阿拉伯手稿转录设计的标注指南，灵感来自文本批评——一种成熟的历史文本编辑方法。随后，我们提出了ATHAAR，一个按照该指南手动标注的新数据集。与以往资源不同，ATHAAR不仅涵盖同一文本的不同抄本、书写风格和内容，还包含数字。基于最先进的VLMs，我们设计了一系列实验，研究模型在不同脚本、章节和论著间的迁移能力。研究发现揭示了现有系统在面对古代科学文本特异性时的局限性。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for language-model post-training, combining dense teacher supervision with training on student-generated trajectories. This creates a feedback loop where each update changes the student and thereby the training distribution that generates subsequent updates. Yet, how this feedback shapes learning and generalization remains poorly understood. We conduct a mechanistic analysis of OPD's learning dynamics, distinguishing the two feedback loop stages: conversion of the distillation signal into parameter updates, and broadcast through which these updates change predictions across prefixes and reshape the rollout distribution. This framework helps us understand both limited student responsiveness despite substantial teacher-student disagreement, and degeneration when updates that improve local teacher agreement also increase the probability of unsuccessful continuations, exposing the student to unreliable supervision in subsequent rollouts. Finally, we show that offline distillation can prepare a student for OPD without significantly improving immediate held-out accuracy. While OPD alone may degrade generation, it can yield substantial accuracy gains after sufficient offline preparation. Together, our results connect teacher supervision, student geometry, and the evolving rollout distribution in determining the learning dynamics of OPD and its effects on downstream performance.
title: Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 在线策略蒸馏的学习动态
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）正成为语言模型后训练的重要范式，结合密集教师监督与学生生成轨迹的训练。这形成了一个反馈循环，每次更新都会改变学生，从而改变后续更新所生成的训练分布。然而，这种反馈如何塑造学习与泛化仍不清楚。我们对OPD的学习动态进行了机制分析，区分了两个反馈循环阶段：将蒸馏信号转化为参数更新，以及通过广播使这些更新改变前缀上的预测并重塑回溯分布。该框架帮助我们理解为何学生在教师-学生差异显著的情况下响应有限，以及为何当提升局部教师一致性的同时也增加了失败延续的概率时，会导致退化，暴露学生在后续回溯中面临不可靠监督。最后，我们发现离线蒸馏可在不显著提升即时保留准确率的情况下，为OPD做好准备。虽然OPD本身可能导致生成质量下降，但在充分离线准备后可带来显著的准确率提升。我们的结果连接了教师监督、学生几何结构与不断演化的回溯分布，共同决定OPD的学习动态及其对下游性能的影响。

summary: Intent-based networking (IBN) promises QoS provisioning in which the network derives the configuration from operator-stated goals. Its first step, translating a natural-language intent into enforceable service-level objectives (SLOs) grounded in a live snapshot of the network state, increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs). These large models add cost and energy to the management loop and typically require multi-GPU, cloud-hosted infrastructure. Can lightweight open LLMs take over this step dependably? We answer this question with a five-dimensional evaluation of ten LLMs with <10B parameters from five families, under four prompting setups, on 716 placement intents. We evaluate translation performance, intent validation, hallucination, energy impact, and robustness to diverse phrasing. The best configurations translate intents with a strict F1 of 0.943 and reject up to 191 of 195 invalid intents. With few-shot reasoning, the strongest models hallucinate unsupported QoS requirements in only about one response in a hundred, whereas the zero-shot setup struggles. A translated intent costs 0.044-0.148 Wh of GPU energy without reasoning, and added energy cost for reasoning pays off for the weaker models. Furthermore, we show that realistic rephrasing lowers the rejection of invalid intents in 15 of 16 configurations for the best-performing models, leaving robust intent validation as a key open challenge for reliable IBN. Our code and data are available: https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo.
title: How Far Can Lightweight LLMs Go in Intent-to-SLO Translation?

title_translated: 轻量级大语言模型在意图到SLO翻译中的极限有多远？
summary_translated: 基于意图的网络（IBN）承诺提供QoS保障，即网络从操作员陈述的目标推导出配置。其第一步是将自然语言意图翻译为基于网络实时状态快照的可执行服务级别目标（SLO），这一过程越来越多地依赖大语言模型（LLMs）。这些大型模型增加了管理环路的成本和能耗，通常需要多GPU、云托管基础设施。轻量级开源LLMs能否可靠承担此步骤？我们通过五维评估对十个参数少于10B的LLMs（来自五个家族）在四种提示设置下，针对716个部署意图进行评估。评估内容包括翻译性能、意图验证、幻觉、能耗影响及对多样表述的鲁棒性。最佳配置的严格F1达到0.943，可拒绝191/195个无效意图。采用少样本推理时，最强模型仅约百分之一的响应中出现不支持的QoS要求，而零样本设置表现较差。翻译一个意图的能耗为0.044–0.148 Wh GPU，无推理时；推理带来的额外能耗对弱模型而言具有回报。此外，我们发现真实重述会使最佳模型在15/16配置中降低无效意图的拒绝率，表明稳健的意图验证仍是实现可靠IBN的关键开放挑战。代码与数据已公开：https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo。

summary: Can large language models (LLMs) advance theoretical computer science and resolve its long-standing open conjectures? To study progress toward this goal, we introduce TCSExam, a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research. It evaluates theorem proving, solver engineering, and constructions alongside direct attempts to resolve open conjectures, capturing both concrete research accomplishments and progress toward long-standing research goals. TCSExam-Full contains 100 expert-reviewed tasks, with submissions checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. TCSExam-Lite selects 20 tasks, five per track, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. The TCSExam Index combines all four tracks: GPT-6 Astra leads Full (71.9), and Opus 5.5 leads Lite (72.3). Full and Lite rankings are strongly aligned across eight shared agents (Spearman's $ρ=0.93$), supporting Lite as a compact, discriminative benchmark. The evaluations yield improved solver outputs and mathematical constructions, together with independently verified special cases and bounds from open-conjecture attempts. TCSExam provides an extensible framework with task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools for reproducible use.
title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
