title_translated: TCSExam：评估前沿大语言模型在理论计算机科学全范围研究中的表现
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能否推动理论计算机科学并解决其长期存在的开放猜想？为研究这一目标的进展，我们提出了TCSExam，一个统一的框架和基准，涵盖理论计算机科学的全部研究领域。它评估定理证明、求解器工程、构造方法以及直接尝试解决开放猜想，既捕捉具体的科研成果，也反映向长期研究目标的进展。TCSExam-Full包含100个专家评审的任务，提交结果通过Lean内核或可执行任务检查器验证。TCSExam-Lite选取20个任务（每类五个），在相同每次尝试预算下将任务尝试次数减少80%。我们在Full版本上评估了八个智能体，在Lite版本上评估了九个。TCSExam指数综合了四个赛道：GPT-6 Astra在Full中领先（71.9分），Opus 5.5在Lite中领先（72.3分）。在八个共享智能体中，Full与Lite排名高度一致（Spearman相关系数ρ=0.93），支持Lite作为紧凑且具有区分力的基准。评估结果带来了改进的求解器输出和数学构造，并独立验证了开放猜想尝试中的特殊案例和边界。TCSExam提供了一个可扩展的框架，包含任务来源、Docker构建配方和评估工具，支持可复现使用。

summary: On-policy distillation trains a student on its own rollouts, so states the teacher would reach but the student does not are seldom supervised. We introduce CoRD (coupled-rollout distillation), which keeps the on-policy loss and moves only the distribution of training states toward the teacher, drawing rollouts from a geometric interpolation of student and teacher through the maximal coupling of speculative decoding. The coupling keeps the student's token wherever the two distributions agree and otherwise substitutes a token from the part of the target the student underweights, so interventions are as rare as any exact sampler allows and recede as the student learns. Across six base students from two model families (Qwen3 and Qwen3.5, 0.6B to 4B), CoRD raises average pass@1 over on-policy distillation by 0.9 to 2.0 points and pass@8 by 1.2 to 3.4 points on five public math benchmarks at equal steps and data. On frozen teacher-reached states, a 4B student trained with CoRD reaches in 16 steps a gap closure that on-policy distillation does not reach in 80, and substitution rules intervening at least as often in other directions fall short of CoRD.
title: CoRD: Coupled Rollouts Fill the Blind Spot of On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: CoRD：耦合回溯填补策略蒸馏的盲区
summary_translated: 基于策略的蒸馏让学生模型在其自身回溯轨迹上进行训练，因此教师模型可能到达但学生未触及的状态很少被监督。我们提出CoRD（耦合回溯蒸馏），在保持基于策略损失的同时，仅将训练状态分布向教师模型移动，通过推测解码的最大耦合实现学生与教师之间的几何插值回溯。该耦合机制在两个分布一致的位置保留学生生成的标记，否则用学生低估的部分目标标记替代，使得干预频率极低，且随着学生学习而逐渐减少。在来自两个模型家族（Qwen3和Qwen3.5，0.6B至4B）的六个基础学生模型上，CoRD在相等步数和数据条件下，使平均pass@1提升0.9至2.0分，pass@8提升1.2至3.4分，在五个公开数学基准测试中表现优异。在冻结的教师可达状态上，一个4B的学生模型经CoRD训练后仅需16步即可达到基于策略蒸馏在80步内仍未达成的差距闭合效果；而其他方向的替代规则即使干预频率更高，也无法超越CoRD。

summary: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly operating over longer horizons with diminishing human oversight, raising the risk of loss of control: systems acting beyond effective human control with potentially irreversible consequences. Because such failures may become observable only after containment is difficult, they must be assessed prospectively. We introduce a behavioural framework that decomposes loss-of-control risk into three factors: misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion. We operationalise these factors through 13 measurable aspects and 29 evaluation tasks, whose scores are combined into a single loss-of-control (LoC) score. Across 13 frontier models, the LoC score shows strong prospective validity, correlating with failure rates in contained long-horizon risk scenarios (Pearson r = 0.84). Risk varies systematically across models and cannot be explained by capability alone. We further show that the framework can guide targeted mitigations: fine-tuning and monitoring directed at diagnosed vulnerabilities reduce failure rates while largely preserving general performance. These results provide a practical basis for predicting, understanding, and mitigating loss-of-control risk before it materialises.
title: A Behavioural Framework for Predicting and Understanding Loss of Control in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Systems
title_translated: 预测与理解前沿人工智能系统失控行为的框架
summary_translated: 前沿人工智能（AI）系统正越来越多地在更长的时间范围内运行，人类监督逐渐减弱，导致失控风险上升：系统行为超出有效人类控制，可能带来不可逆后果。由于此类失败可能仅在难以遏制之后才被观察到，因此必须进行前瞻性评估。我们引入一种行为框架，将失控风险分解为三个因素：动机错位、危害能力增强和监控规避。通过13个可度量方面和29个评估任务对这些因素进行操作化，其得分综合为单一的失控（LoC）评分。在13个前沿模型上的评估显示，LoC评分具有强前瞻性有效性，与受控长周期风险场景中的失败率高度相关（Pearson相关系数r = 0.84）。风险在不同模型间系统性变化，不能仅由能力水平解释。我们进一步表明，该框架可指导针对性缓解措施：针对诊断出的脆弱点进行微调和监控，能有效降低失败率，同时基本保持整体性能。这些结果为在失控发生前预测、理解和缓解风险提供了实用基础。

summary: Conversational agents can retrieve information directly or delegate retrieval to a subagent. This design choice affects how retrieval history is maintained, what context each model call receives, and what information must be re-retrieved in follow-up questions. We compare three designs: skill-based retrieval in the main agent, a non-persistent retrieval subagent that generates a findings response, and our persistent retrieval subagent, which maintains retrieval history across turns and returns retrieved evidence directly to the main agent. Our approach also allows the main agent to request corrections from the same subagent.   We evaluate the three designs on enterprise questions posed independently, within shared conversations, and as dependent follow-ups. Across five multi-turn settings, our approach uses 43.3% fewer recorded agent-model tokens and incurs 45.0% lower estimated API cost than skill-based retrieval, while reducing average response time by 9.1%. Compared with non-persistent retrieval, it reduces response time by 15.6 seconds per question, while using 65.1% more tokens and incurring 29.1% higher estimated API cost.   Our approach shifts the retrieval subagent from producing synthesized responses to maintaining retrieval state and supplying evidence that the main agent can directly evaluate and use for answer generation.
title: Persistent Retrieval for Conversational Agents: A Study of Retrieval Efficiency
title_translated: 对话智能体的持久检索：检索效率研究
summary_translated: 对话智能体可通过直接检索信息或委托子智能体完成检索。这一设计选择影响检索历史的维护方式、每次模型调用所接收的上下文，以及后续问题中需要重新检索的信息量。我们比较了三种设计：主智能体中的基于技能的检索、非持久检索子智能体（生成结论性响应）以及我们的持久检索子智能体——该子智能体在多轮交互中持续维护检索历史，并直接向主智能体返回检索证据。此外，主智能体还可向同一子智能体请求修正。我们在独立提问、共享对话和依赖式后续问题三种场景下评估这三种设计。在五个多轮设置中，我们的方法比基于技能的检索减少了43.3%的记录代理-模型token数量，API成本降低45.0%，平均响应时间减少9.1%。相较于非持久检索，它每问题减少15.6秒响应时间，但token使用量增加65.1%，API成本提高29.1%。我们的方法将检索子智能体的角色从生成合成响应转变为维护检索状态并提供主智能体可直接评估和用于答案生成的证据。

summary: Masked diffusion models generate text by reversing a stochastic masking process. Unlike autoregressive LLMs, which generate text one token at a time, they can reveal many tokens in parallel, at the price of an error, since tokens revealed together are drawn independently. We show that this trade-off maps onto the statistical physics of driven many-particle systems. (i) For any data, the error of parallel generation is the entropy production of the generation process relative to the reversed masking process. (ii) For Markov data, generation is a random sequential adsorption process with labelled gaps, which we solve exactly for any number of steps. (iii) For many steps, the error becomes the dissipation of a slowly driven system: the unmasking schedule plays the role of the driving protocol, the number of steps that of its duration, and the error is set by a thermodynamic metric that we obtain in closed form from the mutual information between tokens. Optimal schedules are geodesics of this metric. The exact solution shows how correlations in the text shape both the error and the quality of the output. The longer the correlations, the more the error concentrates at the start of generation. Schedules that start with small steps then gain more, both in path error and in perplexity, and need fewer steps to reach their asymptotic behaviour.
title: Masked diffusion as random sequential adsorption: an exactly solvable model for parallel decoding
title_translated: 掩码扩散作为随机顺序吸附：一种可精确求解的并行解码模型
summary_translated: 掩码扩散模型通过反转随机掩码过程生成文本。与一次生成一个标记的自回归LLM不同，它们可以并行揭示多个标记，代价是产生错误，因为同时揭示的标记是独立抽取的。我们发现这种权衡映射到了驱动多粒子系统的统计物理。 (i) 对于任意数据，平行生成的误差等于生成过程相对于反向掩码过程的熵产生。 (ii) 对于马尔可夫数据，生成过程是一种带有标签间隙的随机顺序吸附过程，我们对其在任意步骤数下给出了精确解。 (iii) 在多步情况下，误差表现为缓慢驱动系统的耗散：去掩码调度扮演驱动协议角色，步骤数代表持续时间，误差由一个热力学度量决定，该度量可通过标记间的互信息以封闭形式获得。最优调度是该度量下的测地线。精确解揭示了文本中的相关性如何同时影响误差和输出质量。相关性越长，误差越集中在生成初期。起始步长较小随后逐步增大的调度在路径误差和困惑度上均表现更优，且更少步骤即可达到渐近行为。

summary: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.
title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents

title_translated: 生成-排序：面向具身智能体的符号化目标解析学习
summary_translated: 目标解析是将自然语言指令转化为规划器可执行的形式化符号目标的过程。这对具身智能体至关重要，因为此处的任何错误都会传播到后续的所有规划和行动步骤中。高质量的目标解析需要既能生成合适的候选方案，又能可靠地从中进行选择。本文提出一种两阶段的生成-排序方法（Generate-then-Rank）用于具身智能体接口（EAI）中的目标解析。首先，通过监督微调使大语言模型（LLM）适应EAI的输出规范；其次，基于错误的候选输出排序（CORE）方法从模型自身生成的替代输出中学习偏好。我们在具身智能体接口基准测试的家庭场景上进行了实验，评估了包括DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner以及Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B在内的多个开源LLM。所提方法在性能上优于基线模型，包括使用简单提示、思维链及基于知识图谱的方法。

summary: Activation storage is often a bottleneck in sparse autoencoder (SAE) training. We study how many unique activations an SAE needs when its total training budget is fixed. Quality improves rapidly as the buffer grows, then reaches a plateau where replaying the buffer is nearly as effective as using fresh activations throughout training. Beyond this point, additional unique activations bring little benefit to reconstruction or interpretability, so the buffer need not grow with the training budget. We describe this tradeoff between diversity and repetition with a scaling law for limited data. We validate it across dictionary sizes and token budgets, early, middle, and late layers of Llama-3.1, Qwen3 model sizes, and BatchTopK, TopK, and JumpReLU SAEs. Sweeps using mathematical text and Python code test the effect of changing the activation source. Evaluation covers explained variance (EV), reconstruction MSE, feature absorption, automated interpretability, and sparse probing. These results give a practical training rule: choose the smallest buffer that reaches the quality plateau and replay it for the remaining budget. In our experiments, this reduces activation storage by $8\text{--}64\times$ with negligible quality loss.
title: Scaling Laws for SAE Training Data
title_translated: 稀疏自编码器训练数据的缩放规律
summary_translated: 激活值存储通常是稀疏自编码器（SAE）训练中的瓶颈。我们研究在总训练预算固定的情况下，SAE需要多少唯一激活值。当缓冲区规模增大时，模型质量迅速提升，随后达到平台期，此时重放缓冲区中的激活值与持续使用新激活值的效果几乎相当。超过该点后，额外的唯一激活值对重建质量或可解释性几乎没有帮助，因此缓冲区无需随训练预算增长而扩大。我们提出了一个关于有限数据下多样性与重复性的缩放规律。该规律在不同词典大小、token预算、Llama-3.1、Qwen3模型规模以及BatchTopK、TopK和JumpReLU SAE结构中均得到验证。通过数学文本和Python代码作为激活源的实验，测试了激活来源变化的影响。评估指标包括解释方差（EV）、重建均方误差（MSE）、特征吸收、自动可解释性及稀疏探测。这些结果给出了一个实用的训练规则：选择最小能达到质量平台期的缓冲区，并在整个剩余预算中重复使用。在我们的实验中，这使得激活存储减少了8至64倍，且质量损失可忽略不计。

summary: When a base language model is fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), how much of the training data domain leaks into the resulting artifact? This paper studies whether a simple classifier can recover the domain of a fine-tune given only the model artifact (weight deltas, internal activations on a fixed probe set, or generated text) without ever observing the training data. Using one base model (Qwen3.5-0.8B), 36 LoRA fine-tunes are produced over 18 public datasets in five domains (medical, code, mathematics, non-English text, narrative prose), and three feature families are extracted at decreasing levels of access: white-box weights, gray-box activations, and black-box outputs. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) protocol, frozen before any result was seen, tests whether the domain of a fine-tune trained on a previously unseen dataset can be identified. The domain is recoverable well above chance (20%) from gray-box activations (61%) and black-box outputs (64%); white-box weight statistics reach 42%. Contrary to the pre-registered hypothesis that signal decays monotonically from weights to activations to outputs, activations and outputs were more informative than the weight-delta statistics. The black-box result holds unchanged (64%) when only generated text is used, without token probabilities. Domain accuracy is also stable when a third run per dataset is trained on an independently drawn data subsample, and black-box predictions are unaffected by the LoRA rank (8-64). All code and per-run feature vectors are released.
title: Embedding-Space Fingerprinting of LoRA Fine-Tunes: Recovering the Training-Data Domain from the Model Artifact Alone
title_translated: LoRA微调嵌入空间指纹识别：仅从模型产物恢复训练数据领域
summary_translated: 当基础语言模型通过低秩适配（LoRA）进行微调时，其训练数据领域有多少信息会泄露到最终模型产物中？本文研究在仅拥有模型产物（权重增量、固定探测集上的内部激活或生成文本）而从未接触过训练数据的情况下，是否能通过一个简单分类器恢复微调所用的数据领域。使用一个基础模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B），在五个领域（医学、代码、数学、非英语文本、叙事散文）共18个公开数据集上生成了36个LoRA微调版本，并提取了三个层级的特征：白盒权重、灰盒激活和黑盒输出。采用留一数据集排除（LODO）协议，在未观察任何结果前即冻结，测试能否识别出此前未见过数据集的微调领域。结果显示，仅从灰盒激活（61%）和黑盒输出（64%）即可显著高于随机水平（20%）地恢复领域；白盒权重统计达到42%。与预注册假设相反——信号从权重到激活再到输出单调衰减——实际上激活和输出比权重增量统计更具信息量。即使仅使用生成文本（不含概率信息），黑盒结果仍保持不变（64%）。当每个数据集独立采样再训练第三轮时，领域准确率稳定，且黑盒预测不受LoRA秩（8-64）影响。所有代码和每轮的特征向量均已公开。

summary: Mapping behavioral intelligence in malware analysis reports to ATT&CK techniques supports threat analysis and defense, but reliable identification remains challenging. Supporting evidence is often scattered across long, heterogeneous reports, while closely related techniques share behavioral cues and differ only in subtle but decisive details. While large language models (LLMs) can use external knowledge to interpret reports, they may assign techniques based on plausible associations rather than sufficient evidence. We present MEvince, a knowledge-constrained LLM reasoning framework for report-level malware technique identification. Its core is a shared behavioral representation connecting report observations to technique definitions. This representation is built through agentic mining of technique documentation and supports two online stages: 1) primitive-guided extraction uses behavioral primitives to structure LLM-extracted observations, link them to source passages, and group dispersed evidence; 2) evidence-aligned retrieval matches this evidence to technique profiles through the same concepts, retaining likely candidates and confusable alternatives for LLM comparison of distinguishing behaviors. Controls at both stages validate evidence references and check technique-specific requirements. The representation also supports adaptation without parameter updates, where offline agentic audits diagnose concept weaknesses and refine extraction or retrieval policies. We evaluate MEvince against 11 baselines spanning four method families using a dataset of 610 public malware reports referenced by MITRE ATT&CK. MEvince improves exact-ID F1 over the strongest baseline by 17.4%, and its concept-guided retrieval increases gold-label candidate coverage from 31.6% to 47.9%. With a small adaptation set, offline refinement yields further gains and outperforms baselines that update model parameters.
title: MEvince: Knowledge-Constrained LLM Reasoning for Technique Identification from Malware Reports
title_translated: MEvince：基于知识约束的LLM推理以从恶意软件报告中识别技术
summary_translated: 将恶意软件分析报告中的行为情报映射到ATT&CK技术，有助于威胁分析与防御，但可靠识别仍具挑战性。支持证据通常分散在冗长且异构的报告中，而密切相关的技术仅在细微却决定性的细节上存在差异。尽管大语言模型（LLM）可利用外部知识解读报告，但可能基于合理关联而非充分证据分配技术。我们提出MEvince，一种面向报告级恶意软件技术识别的知识约束型LLM推理框架。其核心是一个共享的行为表示，连接报告中的观察与技术定义。该表示通过代理式挖掘技术文档构建，支持两个在线阶段：1）原始引导提取利用行为原语结构化LLM提取的观察结果，将其与原文段落关联并整合分散证据；2）证据对齐检索通过相同概念匹配证据与技术档案，保留可能候选和技术混淆项，供LLM比较区分性行为。两个阶段均设有控制机制，验证证据引用并检查技术特定要求。该表示还支持无需参数更新的适应性调整，离线代理审计可诊断概念弱点并优化提取或检索策略。我们在包含610份由MITRE ATT&CK引用的公开恶意软件报告的数据集上，对比11种基线方法（涵盖四种方法族）。MEvince相较于最强基线，精确识别F1得分提升17.4%，其概念引导的检索将黄金标签候选覆盖率从31.6%提升至47.9%。使用少量适配集进行离线优化进一步提升性能，超越了需更新模型参数的基线方法。

summary: When large language models do multi-step mathematics, a characteristic failure recurs: the model writes one wrong sign token mid-computation -- a cofactor sign, the minus of a recursive integration-by-parts step -- then executes the rest of the arithmetic correctly, and the answer comes out wrong. We ask where inside the network that sign is written. Across six open models spanning 14B to 675B parameters, a per-layer readout shows the wrong sign is committed late -- by MLP layers in the last quarter of the network (70-100% per model and task), a pattern present, where tested (Qwen), in the base model before instruction tuning. The mechanism varies: some models carry fixed "minus-stamp" layers that push a minus regardless of the right answer, others carry amplifiers of whichever sign was already chosen, and Qwen adds a downstream rescue layer that opposes the stamp. The circuit is causal: subtracting a single sign direction from the residual stream flips 13 of 14 held-out minus-written integration-by-parts errors on Llama-3.3-70B, with flips replicating on Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral-Small (24-70% per cell), and with representation-level specificity -- the same dose breaks correctly-minus answers while sparing correct-plus answers where the direction is surgical (0/72 on Llama), and matched random-direction and control-layer interventions are null. Core claims were preregistered with pass criteria frozen in git before held-out data was seen: 23 of 29 checks passed, all misses reported. But causality is not uniform: Phi-4 implements an equally well-localized circuit at the same late depth, yet the identical intervention flips almost nothing -- the sign is written redundantly across ~15 layers with margins several times larger (median 17.8 logits). Localization, we conclude, does not imply steerability: two models can share a circuit location yet differ enormously in how overturnable it is.
title: Localization Does Not Imply Steerability: A Mechanistic Study of Sign Errors in LLM Mathematics

title_translated: 定位不等于可操控性：大语言模型数学推理中符号错误的机制研究
summary_translated: 当大语言模型进行多步数学计算时，一种典型失败反复出现：模型在计算过程中写错了一个符号——如递归分部积分步骤中的系数符号——之后其余算术正确执行，但最终答案错误。我们探究该符号错误在模型内部何时被写入。在六个开放模型（参数量从14B到675B）中，逐层读出分析显示，错误符号是在后期才被确定的——由网络最后四分之一层的MLP层完成（各模型和任务中占比70%-100%），这一模式在测试中（Qwen）也存在于指令微调前的基础模型中。其机制各异：某些模型具有固定的“负号印章”层，无论正确答案如何都强制添加负号；另一些则放大已选符号；Qwen还引入下游救援层来抵消该印章。该电路具有因果性：从残差流中移除单一符号方向，可在Llama-3.3-70B上翻转14个保留样本中13个错误写入负号的分部积分错误，且该翻转现象在Qwen、Gemma和Mistral-Small中复现（每单元24%-70%），同时具备表示层面特异性——相同剂量破坏正确负号答案，但保护正确正号答案（Llama为0/72），而随机方向和对照层干预无效。核心结论在持有数据前于git中预注册，29项检验中有23项通过，所有失败均报告。然而因果性并非普遍：Phi-4在相同深度实现同样精确定位的电路，但相同干预几乎无效果——符号在约15层中冗余书写，边际值数倍于其他模型（中位数17.8 logits）。我们得出结论：定位不意味着可操控性——两个模型可能共享同一电路位置，但在可逆转性上存在巨大差异。

summary: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. Existing benchmarks close the world somewhere, fixing the task, the data, or the timeline, and thereby remove these failures instead of measuring them. We introduce FINCOSMOS, an open-world evaluation paradigm for agents doing financial work. A simulated user holds a hidden strategy sampled from a compositional grammar and reveals it only when asked. The agent receives no data, so it must acquire data from the Web, build its own backtest under a data cutoff, and deliver verifiable results. Grading needs no reference answer. Programs verify point-in-time correctness and recompute every reported metric, the delivered strategy is checked against the hidden specification, and a run is accepted only when the user is satisfied and none of 15 veto checks fails. Across four coding agents and a model without tools in 150 sessions, no session is accepted: every session that the simulated user signed off fails a program check, and agents raise only 54--64\% of the details they were not told. Human experts attribute 88.33\% of failures to the agents. With FINCOSMOS feedback, an agent with persistent memory learned all ten tasks.
title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
title_translated: FINCOSMOS：面向金融领域智能体的开放世界评估范式
summary_translated: 语言智能体在开放网络上为用户工作，而金融领域是信任它们最困难的场景。数据必须来自网络，策略存在于用户头脑中，正确性依赖于时间，因此智能体可能无声失败：用户从未要求的策略、未经验证的数据，或使用未来数据进行回测，都会生成与正确结果同样具有说服力的报告。现有基准将世界封闭起来，固定任务、数据或时间线，从而消除这些失败，而非测量它们。我们提出 FINCOSMOS，一种用于执行金融工作的智能体的开放世界评估范式。模拟用户持有从组合语法中采样的隐藏策略，仅在被询问时才揭示。智能体无法获得任何数据，必须从网络获取数据，在数据截止点构建自己的回测，并交付可验证的结果。评分无需参考答案。程序验证时间点正确性并重新计算每个报告指标，交付的策略需与隐藏规范对比，且只有当用户满意且15项否决检查均未失败时，运行才被接受。在150次会话中，四个编码智能体和一个无工具模型均未通过：所有模拟用户签字通过的会话均在程序检查中失败，且智能体仅报告了未被告知细节的54%–64%。人类专家将88.33%的失败归因于智能体。在 FINCOSMOS 反馈下，具备持续记忆的智能体学会了全部十项任务。

summary: An LLM agent's cost and success depend on its model, its harness, and its environment. In addition to the widely studied directions of parameter tuning and harness optimization, we propose the third direction: optimization over stationary environments. Agents are often deployed in rich environments shared by many tasks, such as a company's Slack workspace or a complex collection of data sources, documents or tickets. We call these environments stationary environments. We introduce EnvOpt, a method for automated end-to-end optimization of stationary environments for any given model and harness, using real or synthetic tasks without needing any graders or reference answers. On AutomationBench, EnvOpt reduces the cost of Claude Haiku 4.5 by 72.7% and raises its pass rate by 14.34%. The same environment transfers to Opus 5, cutting its cost by 68.1% with a 1.34% gain. Added on top of Meta-Harness's optimized harness for Haiku 4.5, it lowers cost by a further 83.4% and adds 11.17% accuracy over Meta-Harness alone. Across 5 benchmarks, EnvOpt significantly reduces the cost of agents while improving or maintaining pass rate, and is transferable to different models and different harnesses. We also discuss common successful and rejected environment optimization strategies during automated optimization. More broadly, our results show that how information is represented to an agent shapes both its cost and its success, making the environment worth optimizing in addition to the parameters and the harness.
title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
title_translated: EnvOpt：智能体环境的自动化优化
summary_translated: 大型语言模型智能体的成本和成功率取决于其模型、工具链以及环境。除了广泛研究的参数调优和工具链优化方向外，我们提出了第三个方向：对静态环境的优化。智能体通常部署在由多个任务共享的丰富环境中，例如公司的Slack工作区或复杂的数据源、文档或工单集合。我们称这些环境为静态环境。我们引入 EnvOpt，一种针对任意给定模型和工具链的静态环境自动化端到端优化方法，无需真实评判者或参考答案，可使用真实或合成任务。在 AutomationBench 上，EnvOpt 将 Claude Haiku 4.5 的成本降低72.7%，并通过率提升14.34%。该环境迁移到 Opus 5 后，成本降低68.1%，通过率提升1.34%。在 Meta-Harness 优化工具链基础上叠加使用，进一步降低83.4%的成本，并比 Meta-Harness 单独使用提升11.17%的准确率。在5个基准测试中，EnvOpt 显著降低了智能体成本，同时保持或提升了通过率，并可迁移至不同模型和工具链。我们还讨论了自动化优化过程中常见的成功与失败环境优化策略。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，信息呈现给智能体的方式既影响其成本也影响其成功率，因此环境本身值得优化，而不仅仅是参数和工具链。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Extrapolative OPD further extends the teacher's log-probability shift relative to a reference policy to construct stronger learning targets. However, existing methods couple extrapolation direction and distance, allowing the magnitude of the teacher's shift to dictate how far the target moves. We propose $D^2$-OPD, decoupling these two factors: a per-prefix hard KL constraint bounds the target's distance from the teacher, while an adaptive combination of the teacher's post-training shift and the initial student--teacher gap determines the extrapolation direction. We optimize the student toward this target using forward KL, providing learning signals even for low-probability tokens. We evaluate three settings: where standard OPD performs well, where it struggles with base-model initialization, and where no teacher reference is available. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, $D^2$-OPD attains the highest score in all three settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.45 points. Ablations validate the contributions of each component.
title: $D^2$-OPD: Separating Direction and Distance in Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: $D^2$-OPD：在外推型在线策略蒸馏中分离方向与距离
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）训练学生模型以匹配教师模型在学生生成前缀上的下一个词分布。外推型 OPD 进一步扩展教师模型相对于参考策略的对数概率偏移，以构建更强的学习目标。然而，现有方法将外推方向与距离耦合在一起，使得教师偏移的幅度决定了目标移动的距离。我们提出 $D^2$-OPD，解耦这两个因素：每个前缀施加硬KL约束以限制目标与教师之间的距离，而教师训练后的偏移与初始学生-教师差距的自适应组合决定外推方向。我们使用前向KL优化学生模型以逼近该目标，即使对于低概率词也能提供学习信号。我们在三种场景下进行评估：标准OPD表现良好、在基础模型初始化下表现不佳，以及无教师参考可用的情况。在数学推理基准测试中，$D^2$-OPD 在所有三种设置下均取得最高得分，相比最强基线最高提升9.45分。消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。

summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.
title: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
title_translated: 组合性不对齐：大型视觉-语言模型安全性的审计
summary_translated: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）易受组合性伤害：图像和提示在单独情况下是无害的，但在模型跨模态推理下变得有害。近期对齐方法在组合安全性基准测试中报告了高分，但LLM裁判仅衡量可观测行为，无法揭示安全性在模型中集成的鲁棒性。我们认为，不对齐提供了对对齐鲁棒性的互补审计。我们首先证明，最小监督微调即可达到与多阶段强化学习流水线相当的LLM裁判分数，因此相似的基准分数本身无法建立鲁棒性。接着我们发现，组合性伤害的识别与拒绝是解耦的：九种标准方向探测方法检测组合性伤害的AUC高达0.99，但消融恢复的方向后，拒绝行为要么保持不变，要么破坏模型连贯性。因此我们提出CMaG，一种无需训练的组合性安全不对齐方法。CMaG通过拒绝与合规的对数概率差来度量拒绝意图，对其关于中间层激活求梯度，并与部分良性样本对比较，以隔离跨模态交互项。对80个示例进行一次反向传播即可得到一条单调将拒绝转化为合规的引导方向。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和LLaVA-1.5-7B上，CMaG使组合安全性得分下降最多达65分，同时超过98%的输出保持连贯性，优于基于梯度的基线；该方向还可迁移至文本显性伤害，并使经过防御性训练加固的模型发生不对齐。因此，组合性安全可能在行为上表现强劲，却仍对针对性内部干预极为脆弱。警告：本文包含不安全的模型输出，包括自残相关引用。

summary: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Its conclusions neither check themselves nor reach the agent. We propose closed-loop evaluation, an evaluation method for deployed agents. It models evaluation as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, and it requires every level's conclusion to trace back to atomic data and to be computed by versioned rules. The method covers four levels of analysis (span, trace, conversation and engagement), measures along a spine of Execution, Substance, Trajectory and Results, treats Conduct as a constraint throughout, and uses Provenance and Adjudication components to certify the evidence and the evaluators. Evaluator agents generated by an Agent Factory carry these components, each with a domain knowledge pack and an adapter harness. Two loops close the evaluation: an inner loop audits the evidence, rules and metrics themselves, and an outer loop uses per-component regression checks to drive agent improvement. We also give a pipeline that runs this process automatically. Using the business-analysis agent SharpInsight as a case and porting the method to public conversation data, we show how problems differ across levels and how evidence-and-rule judgment is more reliable than holistic scoring (ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81; kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63).
title: Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration
title_translated: 闭环智能体评估：分层测量与自我校准
summary_translated: 一旦智能体上线，团队希望了解它是否真正完成任务，而不仅仅是是否抛出错误。然而，大多数评估是一次性的：一次基准测试、查看轨迹、单一分数。其结论既无法自我验证，也无法反馈给智能体。我们提出闭环评估，一种针对已部署智能体的评估方法。它将评估建模为在有偏评判者和被截断结果下的性能估计，并要求每一层级的结论都能追溯到原子数据，并由版本化规则计算得出。该方法涵盖四个分析层次（跨度、轨迹、对话和参与度），沿执行、内容、轨迹和结果的主干进行测量，全程将行为规范作为约束，并使用溯源与裁决组件来认证证据和评估者。由智能体工厂生成的评估者智能体携带这些组件，每个都配备领域知识包和适配器工具链。两个循环闭合评估过程：内环审计证据、规则和指标本身，外环则通过各组件的回归检查驱动智能体改进。我们还提供了一个自动运行该流程的管道。以业务分析智能体SharpInsight为例，并将该方法应用于公开对话数据，我们展示了不同层级的问题差异，以及基于证据与规则的判断比整体评分更可靠（ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81；kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63）。

summary: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to $5\times$ higher peak decode throughput at $4\times$ compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching $26.9\times$ compression at $94.5\%$ of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.
title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
title_translated: LowRAM：测试时可组合的KV缓存压缩中的低秩键与摊销值
summary_translated: 自回归解码依赖于KV缓存，其内存占用随上下文长度线性增长，限制了批处理大小和吞吐量。现有后训练方法利用词元、层和特征维度间的冗余性，或降低数值精度。我们识别出一个互补方向：在每个注意力头中，值很大程度上可由对应的键预测。我们通过值缓存摊销来利用这一特性，在测试时为每个头拟合轻量级预测器，并仅存储重建效果最差的词元残差，实现4倍近无损的值压缩。该预测器可通过元学习初始化以显著降低预填充开销，或在允许一次性成本的场景（如多查询推理）中从零开始拟合。我们将值摊销与跨层低秩键压缩结合，构建出LowRAM，一种非对称压缩流水线，在三种模型族上均保持接近无损。通过每步仅重构部分KV对，LowRAM能保持解码开销最小化，并在4倍压缩下实现高达5倍的峰值解码吞吐量。LowRAM还可与量化和淘汰机制组合，在长上下文上达到26.9倍压缩，性能保留基线的94.5%。这些结果表明，将键和值视为结构上不同的组件，可实现高效、激进且可组合的KV缓存压缩。

summary: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. Under a stated per-deployment contract, both modes preserve the target's output bitwise when its companions change.} Across five {dense} models (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT) and three single-GPU deployments (NVIDIA A6000, A100, and H100), we evaluate our approach on both tinyBenchmarks and BFCL{; we also include initial tensor-parallel experiments on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Both modes preserve target sequences and Top20-logit bits in the reported tests.} At equal delivered work, {BlockLock-Rows} reduces latency by 53.5--55.0\% and improves throughput by 115.2--122.2\% relative to vLLM Batch-Invariant; compared with batch-invariant kernels, it needs no custom kernel implementations and constrains only the protected requests.
title: BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry
title_translated: BlockLock：具有固定批处理几何结构的可重现LLM推理
summary_translated: 可重现的LLM推理要求请求无论批次中其他请求如何变化，都产生相同的输出。现有解决方案以不同方式付出代价：批处理无关内核对每个操作施加约束，而通过固定形状解码隔离预填充（我们的CoRun式基线）则放弃了共享预填充计算并引入解码填充。我们提出BlockLock，它保留共享批处理预填充，并仅固定受保护请求的数值路径：固定该请求所见的几何结构。有两种模式：BlockLock-Rows使用固定宽度行，保留所有请求的批处理解码；BlockLock-Pack采用终端锚定打包并设置隔离的虚拟段，然后提取受保护请求的KV状态用于目标专用解码。在声明的部署契约下，两种模式在同伴请求变化时仍能保持目标输出按位一致。我们在五种密集模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT）和三种单GPU部署（NVIDIA A6000、A100、H100）上评估本方法，涵盖tinyBenchmarks和BFCL；还包含在两块NVIDIA A6000 GPU上的初步张量并行实验。两种模式在报告测试中均保持目标序列和Top20对数概率比特一致。在同等交付工作量下，BlockLock-Rows相比vLLM Batch-Invariant降低延迟53.5–55.0%，吞吐量提升115.2–122.2%；相较于批处理无关内核，无需定制内核实现，仅约束受保护请求。

summary: Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL).   We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards.   Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.
title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: Octopus：用于潜在KV多智能体强化学习的单一大脑、多分支架构
summary_translated: 多智能体LLM系统通过生成具有独立上下文窗口的子智能体并行探索，而单智能体系统则将每一步搜索与验证追加到一条不断增长的轨迹中。然而，现有多智能体框架在各分支间重复前缀KV缓存，通过重新预填充文本摘要交换发现，并在强化学习（RL）过程中扁平化或丢弃跨分支依赖。我们提出Octopus，一种单模型多智能体强化学习框架，其中所有线程共享同一骨干网络，并通过GPU驻留的KV状态有向无环图（DAG）进行协调，通过五个原语（分叉、读取线程、等待线程、回溯、提交）实现协作。Octopus结合三种协同设计机制：（1）零拷贝基数分叉，以O(1)开销创建共享物理KV页的光标视图；（2）仅注意力KV挂载，将兄弟线程的终端KV块直接挂载至全注意力层，绕过线性递归状态（Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2），使任务外劫持减少21倍（从57.9%降至2.7%），同时在零额外KV分配下保留92.2%的完整文本互信息；（3）打包DAG-GRPO训练器，将所有episode分支打包为一次块稀疏注意力遍历，并通过“移除一个分支”的边际奖励分配反事实分支信用。在Qwen3.5-4B上端到端使用GRPO训练，Octopus在BrowseComp-Plus上达到49.6%准确率（比单智能体GRPO在143K上下文高出17.5点，比文本摘要多智能体RL高出12.5点），在OpenResearcher上达到51.2%，优于最大达250倍的密集检索智能体，同时训练吞吐量提升3.3倍，峰值KV内存减少2.8倍。

summary: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) maps the sender's original context tokens to the receiver's vocabulary, providing discrete entity anchors. A Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) lets the receiver query the sender's hidden states for contextual enrichment. The entity anchors ground the bridge's contextual signals to specific entities through the receiver's own self-attention. Across three model families (Llama, Qwen, and Mistral), seven benchmarks, and both communication directions, XBRIDGE outperforms text-based communication on all seven tasks for each model pair while achieving 11x lower latency, and in a same-architecture setting it also exceeds a KV-sharing baseline on six of seven tasks. LEB requires only 264M trainable parameters (3.8% of the receiver), is trained on a small balanced sample set, and adds negligible inference overhead.
title: XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication
title_translated: XBridge：异构LLM通信中的实体基础潜在桥接
summary_translated: 异构多智能体LLM系统（各智能体由不同模型家族驱动）可通过减少冗余推理模式，超越同构配置。然而，现有通信协议要么通过文本传递，丢弃发送方的内部表示，要么要求架构同质性以实现潜在层传输。我们识别出跨架构通信中的实体接地问题：跨注意力桥在不同LLM家族间传递连续表示时，会因稀有词元压缩崩溃而导致实体身份丢失（桥接仅F1约30%）。我们提出XBRIDGE，一种无需解码的通信协议，通过两种机制解决此问题。词汇锚映射（LAM）将发送方原始上下文词元映射到接收方词汇表，提供离散实体锚点。潜在增强桥（LEB）允许接收方查询发送方隐藏状态以获取上下文丰富信息。实体锚点通过接收方自身的自注意力机制，将桥接的上下文信号锚定到特定实体。在三个模型家族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral）、七个基准测试及双向通信中，XBRIDGE在每对模型的七项任务上均优于基于文本的通信，且延迟降低11倍；在同架构设置中，也在六项任务上超过KV共享基线。LEB仅需264M可训练参数（接收方的3.8%），在小规模平衡样本集上训练，且推理开销可忽略不计。
